entries.name: 'Barnabus'
entries.description: 'Barnabus' is a gnoll who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: 'Bigmouth' Thimsen
entries.description: 'Bigmouth' Thimsen is a Baldurian citizen in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Ears' Oohna
entries.description: 'Ears' Oohna is an elven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: 'Grumpo' Daggles
entries.description: 'Grumpo' Daggles is in the Lower City waiting to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Gunny' Sacko
entries.description: 'Gunny' Sacko is concerned about Steel Watchers impinging on freedom in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Logs' Odoolan
entries.description: 'Logs' Odoolan is a citizen punching  Strange Beggar Lumbar in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Loose Lips' Cyrilla
entries.description: 'Loose Lips' Cyrilla is an elven servant to  Lady Jannath who can potentially be encountered in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: 'Plumes' Fronkin
entries.description: 'Plumes' Fronkin is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Suspicious' Foont
entries.description: 'Suspicious' Foont is a halfling civilian attempting to hunt ghosts in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: 'Timothy'
entries.description: 'Timothy' is a gnoll who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: 'Tomelia'
entries.description: 'Tomelia' is a gnoll who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: 'Zinfandel' Gorse
entries.description: 'Zinfandel' Gorse is a halfling wine taster. He is at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Abby
entries.description: Manglin' Abby is a human cultist barbarian in Act Three.

entries.name: Abdirak
entries.description: Abdirak is a human servant of the Maiden of Pain, Loviatar. He is at the Bloodied Shrine in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Abraxa
entries.description: Night Blade Abraxa is a human Night Blade in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Abyssal Gavin
entries.description: Abyssal Gavin is a dead Drow whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Add'ath
entries.description: Raider Add'ath is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Addled Frog
entries.description: The Addled Frog is a frog in the Sunlit Wetlands in Act One.

entries.name: Adrielle
entries.description: Adrielle is a human cleric of Helm who is in Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City during Act Three. She is part of the Anti-Hag Support Group, a group of people who have survived encounters with hags.

entries.name: Aelar
entries.description: Aelar is one of the druids performing the Rite of Thorns during Act One.

entries.name: Aelis (Fist Recruit)
entries.description: Fist Recruit Aelis is a human cleric and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. She is on the Risen Road in Act One.

entries.name: Aelis Siryasius
entries.description: Aelis Siryasius is in the Lower City Sewers of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Afara
entries.description: Griefguard Afara is a Sharran Novice in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Aggralix
entries.description: Fist Aggralix is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Aggy
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Aggy is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Aguta
entries.description: Fist Aguta is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Ahu'u'rag
entries.description: Raider Ahu'u'rag regularly patrols the hallways of Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Aicir Tapol
entries.description: Vutt, disguised as Night Blade Aicir Tapol, is a doppelganger in the Stone Lord's hideout, in the Abandoned Cistern within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Aideen Ni Chuirc
entries.description: Aideen Ni Chuirc is the leader of the Dead Eyes, a group in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Ailis Belt
entries.description: Lady Ailis Belt is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Aischa
entries.description: Black Gauntlet Aischa is a Black Gauntlet of Bane.

entries.name: Akabi
entries.description: Akabi is a djinni in Rivington during Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. He is a performer at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington, located at X: -68 Y: -75 where he hosts a Spin the Wheel game.

entries.name: Alan Alyth
entries.description: Alan Alyth is the owner and bartender of the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Albert
entries.description: Albert is a child with his dog in the Steeps district of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Alembrosius
entries.description: Alembrosius is a Human child in the Eastway district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Alexander Rainforest
entries.description: Alexander Rainforest was a citizen of Baldur's Gate. He was working as an ombudsman in Grey Harbour Docks in Lower City. When the party reaches him in Act Three, Rainforest is already dead.

entries.name: Alfira
entries.description: Alfira is a tiefling bard and a Temporary Companion in Baldur's Gate 3. She is at the Emerald Grove on a cliff overlooking the ritual, trying to compose a song.

entries.name: Alia Durinbold
entries.description: Lady Alia Durinbold is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Enver Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Alice Althea
entries.description: Alice Althea is an elven customer hoping to buy necromantic charms in the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Allandra Grey
entries.description: Flood Tide Allandra Grey is the Flood Tide of the Water Queen's House temple in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Allymer
entries.description: Allymer is a human commoner in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Amek
entries.description: Amek is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Aminah
entries.description: Fist of Bane Aminah is a duergar cultist of Bane in the Steel Watch Foundry next to  Fist of Bane Polandulus.

entries.name: Amira
entries.description: Mamzell Amira is the human proprietor of Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Amnos
entries.description: Amnos, named in-game as Dead Caravan Agent, was a human merchant who died along the Risen Road during Act One, near the bloated hyenas.

entries.name: Amphol
entries.description: Dockworker Amphol appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Ancient Giant Eagle
entries.description: The Ancient Giant Eagle is a type of beast creature in her nest atop the roof of the Rosymorn Monastery in Act One.

entries.name: Anders
entries.description: Anders is a human former paladin of  Tyr in Act One. He is hunting for  Karlach with his companions along the Risen Road.

entries.name: Anderson
entries.description: Fist Anderson is a halfling wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Andorn
entries.description: Andorn guards the Chapel Entrance while his friends raid the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Andrick
entries.description: Andrick is a novice of the Absolute. He is searching the Wilderness for survivors of the Nautiloid Wreck alongside his fellow believers  Edowin and  Brynna.

entries.name: Andrik
entries.description: Andrik is an Undead Vampire Spawn imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon. He is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by  Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn.

entries.name: Angevin Troy
entries.description: Angevin Troy is a drunk sailor in the Blushing Mermaid in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Animated Armour (creature)
entries.description: Animated Armour is a construct in Baldur's Gate 3. They are in the Arcane Tower, Grymforge, and Sorcerous Sundries. Animated Armour can be disabled by anti-magic effects.

entries.name: Anita Fischer
entries.description: Anita Fischer is a grieving mother in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Anna Lidwin
entries.description: Anna Lidwin, also known as Sister Lidwin, is a Zealous Assistant who also functions as a trader in Act Two in the House of Healing.

entries.name: Annathorn Rose
entries.description: Annathorn Rose is a dead Drow whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Anouk
entries.description: Fist of Bane Anouk is a duergar cultist of Bane in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Ansur
entries.description: Ansur is an undead dragon found in Baldur's Gate 3. Formerly a bronze dragon nicknamed "The Waiting Storm" and the "Heart of the Gate", Ansur was generally thought to be mere legend. Depending on the party's actions, either  Ulder Ravengard,  Counsellor Florrick, or  Cordula Eltan reveals that Ansur is very real, offering the party a book which starts their journey to seek Ansur and its help against the Absolute.

entries.name: Antinia
entries.description: Antinia the Goon is a Human in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She is near the Grey Harbour Docks, as part of  Churg Elvek's mob, ready to bring  Volo to "justice".

entries.name: Antinnia
entries.description: Quivers Antinnia is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Antony
entries.description: Harper Antony is a Harper ranger patrolling Last Light Inn during Act Two. Depending on party choices in Acts Two and Three, Antony can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

entries.name: Antwun Dufay
entries.description: Chamberlain Dufay is a deceased vampire spawn in the service of Cazador Szarr.

entries.name: Anya
entries.description: Sister Anya is an undead nurse in the House of Healing, situated in the town of Reithwin, during Act Two.

entries.name: Apikusis
entries.description: Apikusis is a half-elven druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Apostle of Myrkul
entries.description: The Apostle of Myrkul is a powerful enemy that serves as the final boss of Act Two.

entries.name: Arabella
entries.description: Arabella is a tiefling child in the Emerald Grove during Act One. She is the daughter of  Locke and  Komira.

entries.name: Aradin Beno
entries.description: Aradin is a Human Fighter who initially appears in Act One. He and his adventuring party are searching for a treasure called The Nightsong.

entries.name: Araj Oblodra
entries.description: Araj Oblodra is a drow trader and blood-focused alchemist who is in Moonrise Towers and, later, the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. Other than the items she sells, she also offers unique potions in exchange for samples of blood, and asks to speak with  Astarion.

entries.name: Aran Elomar
entries.description: Aran Elomar is a human wine taster. He is at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Aranea
entries.description: Aranea is a spider summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Spider Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Aranea "upgrades" to  Aranea Major once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Aranea Aculeata once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Aranea Aculeata
entries.description: Aranea Aculeata is a spider summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Spider Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Aranea Aculeata is the fully upgraded form of  Aranea and  Aranea Major once the Beast Master has reached level 11.

entries.name: Aranea Major
entries.description: Aranea Major is a spider summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Spider Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Aranea Major is upgraded from  Aranea once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Aranea Aculeata once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Arborio Rolfin
entries.description: Arborio Rolfin is in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Arcagh
entries.description: Arcagh is a petrified drow fighter in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Archer Velicia
entries.description: Archer Velicia is an undercover Harper posing as a member of The Guild, who can be encountered on the shore west of Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Archivist
entries.description: The Archivist is a tiefling who watches over  Raphael's precious collection in the Archives of the House of Hope.

entries.name: Arden
entries.description: Zealot Arden oversees the cargo at the end of the Moonrise Tower Docks in Act Two.

entries.name: Arensen
entries.description: Fist 'Edge' Arensen is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is located in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Arfur Gregorio
entries.description: Arfur Gregorio is a human in Baldur's Gate 3. He is a toymaker living in Rivington, in his house Arfur's Mansion. He has a mildly flamboyant personality and questionable business partners.

entries.name: Argram
entries.description: Alchemist Argram is a duergar alchemist and is part of  Corsair Greymon's crew in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Arka
entries.description: Arka is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove. She is  Kanon's sister and  Memnos' close friend, as well as a guard atop the grove's ramparts.

entries.name: Arkleia Oloril
entries.description: Arkleia Oloril is the quartermaster of the Flaming Fist. She appears in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Armoured Owlbear
entries.description: Through Dammon's special brew, the Owlbear Cub is transformed into the Armoured Owlbear.

entries.name: Arne Jacobson
entries.description: Arne Jacobson is an unhappy human refugee in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Arnell Hallowleaf
entries.description: Arnell Hallowleaf is a high elven Werewolf,  Selûnite, and father of  Shadowheart. He can potentially become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Arrinye
entries.description: Fist Arrinye is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Arron
entries.description: Arron is a halfling trader in The Hollow of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Art Cullagh
entries.description: Art Cullagh is a Flaming Fist at Last Light Inn X: -67 Y: 167 abed, unresponsive, and singing about  Thaniel during Act Two.

entries.name: Arthus
entries.description: Harper Arthus is a gruff high half-elf barbarian and Harper in Act Two.

entries.name: Artimezt
entries.description: Artimezt is a petrified drow ranger in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Arves
entries.description: Arves Silvermount is a human who is outside the House of Grief in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Asharak
entries.description: Asharak is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is a combat and weapons trainer for the children.

entries.name: Asparagus Mhallie
entries.description: Asparagus Mhallie is a recent arrival to Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Astarion
entries.description:
Astarion Ancunín is an Origin character and recruitable companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a high elven rogue with the Charlatan background. Astarion can be first found west of the Nautiloid Wreck during Act One.
A vampire spawn previously under the control of  Cazador Szarr until being abducted by the Nautiloid, Astarion is set on exacting revenge upon Cazador and becoming free, no matter the consequences.

entries.name: Asthena
entries.description: Servant Asthena appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Astoundo the Greater
entries.description: Astoundo the Greater is performing a show with two wizards in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Astoundo the Lesser
entries.description: Astoundo the Lesser is performing a show with two wizards in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Astyl
entries.description: Youth Astyl is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Asumi
entries.description: Asumi is a human commoner. She is visiting the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Aubree
entries.description: Aubree is a Flaming Fist led by  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.

entries.name: Aubrey
entries.description: Aubrey is a deceased high elf commoner in the Graveyard of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Augur Harxkellan
entries.description: Augur Harxkellan is a zealous gold dragonborn preacher in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Auntie Ethel
entries.description: Auntie Ethel is a fussy trader of potions, lotions, quirks, and sundries who is first located in The Hollow of the Emerald Grove. Later, she returns to her home at the Riverside Teahouse in the Sunlit Wetlands.

entries.name: Aurelia
entries.description: Aurelia is a vampire spawn enslaved to  Cazador Szarr, and one of  Astarion's siblings. She may appear at camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Avery (Graveyard)
entries.description: Avery is a deceased high elf commoner in the Graveyard of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Avery Sonshal
entries.description: Avery Sonshal is a shopkeeper of the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City Baldur's Gate, during Act Three. He can be located and spoken with while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Avgarioletta
entries.description: Avgarioletta is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Avourel
entries.description: Avourel is a retired Flaming Fist who is still adjusting to retirement. Avourel is with a group of retirees in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Aylin
entries.description: Dame Aylin, also known by the moniker Nightsong, is an Aasimar and daughter of  Selûne who appears in Baldur's Gate 3. She is first introduced during Act Two, and her story plays a key role in the mysteries surrounding the Shadow-Cursed Lands and Moonrise Towers. She can become a Camp Follower and later an Attached Follower.

entries.name: Ayo Armbrust
entries.description: Ayo Armbrust works as a tailor in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Azak
entries.description: Tracker Azak is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Azari
entries.description: Fist Azari is human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Ba'akreth
entries.description: Youth Ba’akreth is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Baalfe
entries.description: Guard Baalfe is a human guard in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Babyjowls
entries.description: Babyjowls is a member of the Guild that can sometimes be found in the Guildhall in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Bad Twin Bubbins
entries.description: Bad Twin Bubbins is a member of The Guild.

entries.name: Badger
entries.description: Badgers are a type of Beast creature in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Baelen Bonecloak
entries.description: Baelen Bonecloak is a dwarf in the Dread Hollow. He is trapped in the Bibberbang Grotto to the northwest of the Myconid Colony as related during the ⁠Find the Mushroom Picker quest given by his wife,  Derryth Bonecloak. If he survives this encounter, he eventually relocates to Bonecloak's Apothecary in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Baff Elkhorn
entries.description: Baff Elkhorn is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Bagdog
entries.description: Fist of Bane Bagdog is a half-orc cultist of Bane who is in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Bailey
entries.description: Servant Bailey is a human servant to  Lady Jannath, who can potentially be encountered on the second floor of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Bakshi
entries.description: Manip Bakshi is a human cleric and a  member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Bal
entries.description: Tracker Bal is a goblin stationed at the checkpoint just before the entrance of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Bala Ofran
entries.description: Bala Ofran is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, is enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Balduran
entries.description: Balduran is a legendary historical figure mentioned in Baldur's Gate 3, credited with the founding of Baldur's Gate among other accomplishments. Several statues found within the game depict his likeness.

entries.name: Balgor
entries.description: Balgor is a dwarven resident of Rivington. He is skeptical of the complaints about the treatment of their letters at the Sword Coast Couriers during Act Three.

entries.name: Balthazar
entries.description: Balthazar is an Undead necromancer, who can first be encountered in the Gauntlet of Shar during Act Two.

entries.name: Bao'ek'nuk
entries.description: Bao'ek'nuk is a bugbear located in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Barcus Wroot
entries.description: Barcus Wroot is an unfortunate deep gnome searching for his friend,  Wulbren Bongle. He can be first be found tied to a windmill in the Blighted Village and can later become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Bareki
entries.description: Voiceless Penitent Bareki is a trader in Baldur's Gate 3 during Act Three.

entries.name: Baretha
entries.description: Sarth Baretha can be found along the Mountain Pass during Act One.

entries.name: Barnz
entries.description: Barnz is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, and is found in the Abandoned Cistern in the Lower City Sewers during Act Three.

entries.name: Barsik
entries.description: Barsik is a medium haired black and white Cat with yellow eyes in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Barth
entries.description: Barth is a High Half-Elf adventurer travelling with  Aradin Beno and  Remira in Act One.

entries.name: Barton
entries.description: Barton is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Bastian d'Zinn
entries.description: Bastian d'Zinn is a wealthy human civilian fuming at being the target of a prank by  Rhaneld, whom he considers to be rabble, outside Elerrathin's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Bat (vampire)
entries.description: This Bat is a special form available to  Astarion during the epilogue when certain story conditions have been met.

entries.name: Battrick Degronce
entries.description: Battrick Degronce is a gnome civilian. He is complaining to  Fist Jimi Borleas about the smell coming from Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Baxta
entries.description: Baxta is a Sharran Sentry in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Baz Hopbank
entries.description: Baz Hopbank is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Bear (wild shape)
entries.description: Bear is a large beast that druids can transform into using the  Wild Shape: Bear ability.

entries.name: Bearclaw
entries.description: Bearclaw is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the player's party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Beatrice Provoss
entries.description: Lady Beatrice Provoss is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Becca
entries.description: Becca is a human child. He is visiting the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Bel
entries.description: Adept Bel patrols the area east of Moonrise Towers around the Docks during Act Two.

entries.name: Beldron
entries.description: Beldron is an enslaved Ironhand deep gnome in the Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Belford Willoughby
entries.description: Belford Willoughby is a human who supervises his father,  Harvard Willoughby, at the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Bella (Bloomridge Park)
entries.description: Fist Bella is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Bella (Wyrm's Rock Fortress)
entries.description: Fist Bella is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Bellar
entries.description: Bellar is a human in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Bellora Truscott
entries.description: Bellora Truscott is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Belron Strongstep
entries.description: Belron Strongstep is a dwarven refugee in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Belub
entries.description: Acolyte Belub watches over a group of new Absolutist recruits at Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Ben Golewits
entries.description: Ben Golewits is a Human refugee living in Arfur's Mansion in Act Three. He is inside the house along with his wife  Marpha and daughter  Cinta.

entries.name: Benferlaen Plum
entries.description: Benferlaen Plum is a dead High Elf whose corpse is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Benji
entries.description: Benji is a ghoul at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three. As "principal sniffer," its job is to sniff everyone who wants to enter the circus. It is the assistant of an elven handler,  Klaus.

entries.name: Bennel
entries.description: Zealot Bennel is a seasoned human Zealot of the Absolute and officer in Act Two. He is on the first floor balcony of Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Benryn
entries.description: Benryn is in Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Benta
entries.description: Booyahg Benta is a goblin raider in Act One.

entries.name: Beorn Wunterbrood
entries.description: Beorn Wunterbrood is a Flaming Fist who appears in the Watch Citadel of High Hall during Act 3 to rally the forces of Baldur's Gate against the Netherbrain. He can be found alongside all the allies whom the player has gathered during the Gather Your Allies quest.

entries.name: Bering Gahorst
entries.description: Bering Gahorst is in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Bernard
entries.description: Bernard is the Construct guardian of the Arcane Tower in the Underdark. Created by the tower's owner, Lenore De Hurst, Bernard was designed for both protection and companionship.

entries.name: Bernyr
entries.description: Worker Bernyr is a gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Bert Adams
entries.description: Bert 'The Weasel' Adams, disguised as a Tipplesome Patron, is a Redcap Mystic Cannoneer in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Bertram Kostaka
entries.description: Bertram Kostaka is an elderly man separated from his partner in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Beulla Sandfoot
entries.description: Beulla Sandfoot is a halfling food merchant. She is conversing with  Fyrd Nuugh on a pier gazebo outside of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Bex
entries.description: Bex is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She is married to  Danis.

entries.name: Bez
entries.description: Warrior Bez is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Big Clive
entries.description: Big Clive is a human customer of the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Big Liar Bronzon
entries.description: Big Liar Bronzon is a half-orc fisherman trying to fish with her buddies in the waters near the Water Queen's House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Bill
entries.description: Brother Bill is a member of the Open Hand Temple.

entries.name: Billigan Indigo
entries.description: Billigan Indigo is a Human refugee. He is waiting to enter Baldur's Gate with his family through the South Span Checkpoint in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Billy

entries.name: Companions
entries.description:
Companions are playable characters who can join and fight alongside the player character. Each has their own motivations, personality, and approval, which increases or decreases according to choices made throughout the game. At high approval levels, many companions can be romanced. Conversely, a companion may leave the party or even try to kill the player character if their approval becomes too low.
The default class of companions can be changed. However, for story purposes, the game acts as if they still have their original class.

entries.description: Cyril is an emotive Flaming Fist under the command of  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.

entries.name: D'hak
entries.description: D'hak is a wolf in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Daddy
entries.description: Daddy is a unique Wraith in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. It is bound in service to the cursed child  Oliver.

entries.name: Dadger
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Dadger is a human member of the Cashguard, in the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dain
entries.description: Gauntlet Dain is a human cleric serving as a corporal to the Flaming Fist during Act One.

entries.name: Daine
entries.description: Daine is in Moonrise Towers on the first floor balcony during Act Two.

entries.name: Dairow Vin
entries.description: Dairow Vin is a tiefling who can be found Act Three.

entries.name: Dal Lightspark
entries.description: Harper Lightspark is a dead gold dwarven Harper whose corpse is in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 92 Y: 107, close to  He Who Was. He, and two other Harpers, went on an expedition to scout the boundaries of the Shadow Curse, before eventually getting lost and succumbing to it before they could make it back to the Last Light Inn.

entries.name: Dalthar
entries.description: Dalthar is a duergar at Grymforge in Act One.

entries.name: Dalyria
entries.description: Dalyria is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador, and one of  Astarion's siblings.

entries.name: Damays
entries.description: Damays and  Nymessa are discussing a captive's fate in the Wilderness during Act One.

entries.name: Dame Guisarme
entries.description: Dame Guisarme is a gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Dammon
entries.description: Dammon is a tiefling blacksmith and trader who fled Elturel with a group of tiefling refugees.

entries.name: Dandi Thistlepetal
entries.description: Dandi Thistlepetal is a Gnome refugee in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Danfora of the Kingfish
entries.description: Danfora of the Kingfish is a dead Drow whose is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Danis
entries.description: Danis is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is married to  Bex.

entries.name: Danna
entries.description: Danna is a Flameshade duergar who can be found in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Dannbo Indigo
entries.description: Dannbo Indigo is a human child. He is waiting to get into Baldur's Gate with his family at the South Span Checkpoint in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Danton
entries.description: Danton is a Mephistopheles Tiefling Druid. As a hireling, he can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Danzo Arkwright
entries.description: Danzo Arkwright is the owner of Sword Coast Couriers postal service in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Darbonna
entries.description: Fist Healer Darbonna is a human cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Darlie
entries.description: Cook Darlie is a staff member in Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

entries.name: Darra
entries.description: Darra is a goblin who can be met at Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Darragh
entries.description: Harper Darragh is a gold dwarven fighter and Harper who guards the entrance to Last Light Inn in Act Two.

entries.name: Dart Dirtwood
entries.description: Dart Dirtwood is a Dwarf in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. He is near the Grey Harbour Docks, as part of  Churg Elvek's mob, ready to bring  Volo to "justice".

entries.name: Darvis
entries.description: Darvis is a dwarven dockworker outside Flymm Cargo in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dashkent Moliver
entries.description: Dashkent Moliver is the custodian of Fraygo's Flophouse in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Dead Drow
entries.description: Dead Drow is in the torchstalk gulch area of the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Dead Halfling (Ancient Lair)
entries.description: Dead Halfling is a character in the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

entries.name: Dead Human (Fighter, Ancient Lair)
entries.description: Dead Human (Fighter) is a character in the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

entries.name: Dead Human (Wizard, Ancient Lair)
entries.description: Dead Human (Wizard) is a character in the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

entries.name: Dead Mind Flayer (Goblin Camp)
entries.description: Dead Mind Flayer can be found in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Dead Myconid
entries.description: Dead Myconid is a myconid character in the Underdark.

entries.name: Dead Myconid Sprout
entries.description: Dead Myconid Sprout is a myconid character in the Underdark.

entries.name: Dead Tiefling
entries.description: Dead Tiefling is a corpse in the Blighted Village next to  Lump the Enlightened.

entries.name: Dead Whitburn Servant
entries.description: Dead Whitburn Servant is a deceased member of the The Watch in the Upper City in Act Three.

entries.name: Death's Head of Bhaal
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal is an archetype of NPC that are members of the Cult of Bhaal and are found throughout the Bhaal Temple and other areas during Act Three.

entries.name: Debin
entries.description: Fist Debin is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Deedle Ofran
entries.description: Deedle Ofran is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Deelia
entries.description: Saer Deelia is a human civilian who can be found near the Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Deep Rothé (myconid colony)
entries.description: This Deep Rothé is livestock at the Myconid Colony in Act One. It can be spoken to using  Speak with Animals.

entries.name: Deep Rothé Calf
entries.description: One Deep Rothé Calf can be encountered in the game. It is in Grymforge near the  Elder Rothé at X: -656 Y: 398. It can be spoken to using  Speak with Animals.

entries.name: Deera
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Deera is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Deeziks Tormo
entries.description: Deeziks Tormo appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Dellinjah Dax
entries.description: Night Blade Dellinjah Dax is a human Night Blade found in the Stone Lord's hideout in the Abandoned Cistern within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dellys
entries.description: Dellys is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Delverdenn
entries.description: Delverdenn is a shield dwarven Warlock and member of the Society of Brilliance.

entries.name: Delwaer Jeth
entries.description: Lord Delwaer Jeth is an elven noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Delyarna
entries.description: Delyarna is concerned about crime and house prices in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Demir
entries.description: Demir is searching for his sister in the Sunlit Wetlands during Act One.

entries.name: Derryth Bonecloak
entries.description: Derryth Bonecloak is a gold dwarf and trader in Ebonlake Grotto.

entries.name: Derysia
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Derysia is a human Death's Head of Bhaal in the Bhaal Temple in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Deva (Banite)
entries.description: Devas are a type of Celestial being.

entries.name: Devella Fountainhead
entries.description: Devella Fountainhead is a constable of the Flaming Fist who can be encountered investigating a crime scene in the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Devoured Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Devoured Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to Raphael.

entries.name: Dextor
entries.description: Sapper Dextor is a goblin sapper in Act One.

entries.name: Dez Kanshaw
entries.description: Dez Kanshaw is a rock gnome in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dhoria
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Dhoria is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dhourn
entries.description: Dhourn is a petrified drow wizard in the Underdark, west of the Selûnite Outpost.

entries.name: Diallo
entries.description: Fist Diallo is a human member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Dickon
entries.description: Dickon can be found behind the Blushing Mermaid in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Dilgar Sneese
entries.description: Dilgar Sneese is a rock gnome follower of Umberlee. She is praying at an altar in Act Three.

entries.name: Dillard Portyr
entries.description: Duke Dillard Portyr is a Duke of Baldur's Gate and a member of the  Council of Four. He is the uncle of  Liara Portyr.

entries.name: Dimples Backster
entries.description: Dimples Backster is a gnome member of  Zenovia's gang and member of The Guild. He is outside  Arfur Gregorio's mansion in Rivington.

entries.name: Dinu
entries.description: Footman Dinu is a staff member in Wyrm's Rock Fortress, present at the ceremony of  Enver Gortash's ordaining as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Diomira Trellis
entries.description: Diomira Trellis is an Untaken of Umberlee who can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dion
entries.description: Gauntlet Dion is a Flaming Fist killed by a githyanki patrol along the Risen Road during Act One.

entries.name: Dire Raven
entries.description: Dire Raven is a raven wild shape available to druids via  Wild Shape: Dire Raven.

entries.name: Dire Wolf
entries.description: A Dire Wolf is an oversized wolf which can be found throughout Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Dire Wolf (wild shape)
entries.description: Dire Wolf is a wolf wild shape available to druids via  Wild Shape: Wolf.

entries.name: Discoria
entries.description: Fist Discoria is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dishevelled Chicken
entries.description: Dishevelled Chicken is a beast potentially found in the Goblin Camp in Act One. A plaything for the goblins, the frightened fowl is constantly chased by  Devout Mezzka or forced to take part in  Krolla's chicken chasing games.

entries.name: Distressed Patient
entries.description: Distressed Patient is a human subject used in  Malus Thorm's twisted medical lectures in Act Two.

entries.name: Djingo
entries.description: Trader Djingo is a gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dogaletto
entries.description: Night Blade Dogaletto is a human Night Blade found in the Undercity outside the Guildhall in Act Three.

entries.name: Doggy
entries.description: Doggy is a unique Construct in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in the service of the curse-bound child  Oliver. Despite appearing as a Shadow and having similar abilities to a  Shadow Mastiff, it is a construct, not an undead or a monstrosity.

entries.name: Dohna
entries.description: Dohna is a Sharran Novice in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dokksill
entries.description: Saer Dokksill is a half-elven noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Dolia
entries.description: Dolia is a human child. She is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Dollay
entries.description: Dollay is a Sharran Novice within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dollivar Noot
entries.description: Dollivar Noot is a gold dwarf sailor at the Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Dolly Dolly Dolly
entries.description: Dolly Dolly Dolly or Dolly Thrice is a pixie trapped in the  Moonlantern carried by  Kar'niss, a drider travelling the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two.

entries.name: Dolor
entries.description: Dolor is a serial killer seeking to gain the Bhaalist title of Unholy Assassin by impressing the Murder Tribunal. He is the son of  Ffion Goldgrind, who was a sex worker at Sharess' Caress before being murdered by Dolor. He is first encountered under the false name Master Meztli.

entries.name: Dominica Arsetz
entries.description: Dominica Arsetz is one of the Gur, the human nomadic tribe. She is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3.

entries.name: Don't-Call-Me-Runt
entries.description: Don't-Call-Me-Runt is a halfling member of The Guild who guards the Guildhall entrance in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Doni
entries.description: Doni is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.  Rikka is his guardian.

entries.name: Donner
entries.description: Harper Donner is a Harper who guards and reinforces the barriers leading into the main plaza of Last Light Inn during Act Two.

entries.name: Donnick
entries.description: Brother Donnick is a member of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Doora Thumbfoot
entries.description: Doora Thumbfoot is a lightfoot halfling in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Doozy the Dunce
entries.description: Doozy the Dunce is a member of the Guild that can sometimes be found in the Guildhall in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dor'il
entries.description: Warrior Dor'il is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Dorghan
entries.description: Saer Dorghan is a deceased high half-elf noble who can be found dead in the Bhaal Temple during Act Three.

entries.name: Dorikel
entries.description: Adept Dorikel is a drow Adept of the Absolute in Moonrise Towers during Act Two. He is stationed outside the main throne room, alongside  Adept Furek.

entries.name: Dorrich Manne
entries.description: Dorrich Manne is a Halfling in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Drana Hoyte
entries.description: Saer Drana Hoyte is a halfling civilian. She appears to be lost and is near the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Drar
entries.description: Drar is a duergar ranger at Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Drarra
entries.description: Drarra is an audience member watching the magic show in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dravo Flymm
entries.description: Dravo Flymm is a human who runs Flymm's Cobblers along with his wife,  Sally Flymm. He is also the father of  Enver Gortash. Dravo and Sally are available to trade with, selling a small selection of camp shoes.

entries.name: Dream Guardian
entries.description:
The Dream Guardian is a mysterious armoured figure that interacts with the player character and their party throughout the game.
Their appearance is specific to each member of the party, with Karlach describing them as a "golden paladin" and Gale referring to them as female, while the player character sees a version created by the player which can be any gender and playable race except dragonborn. Their default appearance in character creation is a female Lolth-sworn drow.

entries.name: Drenn
entries.description: Drenn is a goblin who can be met at Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Dresten
entries.description: Fist Dresten is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Dribbles
entries.description: Fumm, disguised as Dribbles the Clown, works at the Circus of the Last Days as a clown. He can be found at the Circus in Rivington in Act 3, as well as various locations around Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Drim
entries.description: Adventurer Drim is a guest of Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Dringo
entries.description: Oyster Boy Dringo works at the kennel outside Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Drongo Bixworth
entries.description: Drongo Bixworth is being interrogated in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Droo Falbo
entries.description: Droo Falbo is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond. He is enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Droona Shveitz
entries.description: Droona Shveitz is a dwarf standing in the Graveyard of the Lower City.

entries.name: Dror Ragzlin
entries.description: Dror Ragzlin is one of three bosses at the Goblin Camp who work for the Cult of the Absolute. The goblins threaten the Emerald Grove and tiefling refugees.

entries.name: Dror Ragzlin/Zombie
entries.description: Zombie Dror Ragzlin is Dror Ragzlin who died during Act One and is now transformed into a Zombie.

entries.name: Droralias Dryselis
entries.description: Droralias Dryselis is a Dragonborn who, like her sister  Listelia Dryselis, was a smuggler for the Knights of the Shield before perishing to the Absolute.

entries.name: Drubella
entries.description: Seawind Slow-Boat Drubella is a Savage Seawind of Umberlee who appears in Act Three.

entries.name: Druggag
entries.description: Druggag is discussing the refugee crisis near the entrance of Bloomridge Park in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Druk
entries.description: Warrior Druk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Drussuvissill
entries.description: Drussuvissill is a farmer who recently arrived in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Drybeldiyx
entries.description: Drybeldiyx is a dragonborn who is concerned about access to fresh water in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Dryfle Doon
entries.description: Dryfle Doon travelled to Baldur's Gate with two companions during Act Three.

entries.name: Dubos Clodds
entries.description: Dubos Clodds appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Duckie Verish
entries.description:
Duckie Verish is a necromancer
 of the Cult of Myrkul found in Act Two. She appears in the Moonrise Towers Prison after the party launch ⁠the assault on the cult.

entries.name: Duddamoor
entries.description: Fist Duddamoor is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Duddy Dudderken
entries.description: Duddy Dudderken is one of the children at the square in front of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Dugg
entries.description: Cashguard Dugg, is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Dulbers Frint
entries.description: Dulbers Frint is a deep gnome member of Clan Ironhand.

entries.name: Dullwill
entries.description: Tracker Dullwill is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Dunnol
entries.description: Mind Master Dunnol is a duergar in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Duranga
entries.description: Fist Healer Duranga is a dwarven healer and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Duver Rillyn
entries.description: Duver Rillyn is a Werewolf in the ballroom of Cazador Szarr's palace.

entries.name: Dying Stone Lord Thug
entries.description: The Dying Stone Lord Thug is a Human character who is a member of the Stone Lord's crew in Act Three.

entries.name: Dyrovell
entries.description: Dyrovell is a human child in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Dyrr'kas
entries.description: Youth Dyrr'kas is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Earno Diggums
entries.description: Earno Diggums is a dockworker attempting to make deliveries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Earspoon
entries.description: Earspoon is a dwarven member of the Rivington rats visiting Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing. He is whispering to  Borgus Elamin.

entries.name: Ebber
entries.description: Watchman Ebber is a member of the City Watch in the Upper City in Act Three. He attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute.

entries.name: Echo of a Lost Love
entries.description: Echo of a Lost Love is the ghost of Kerri Evenfield who was  Oskar Fevras's past girlfriend.

entries.name: Echo of Abazigal
entries.description: Echo of Abazigal is a ghost of a blue dragon Bhaalspawn. His ghost is disguised as a dragonborn. He was one of the members of  the Five during the  Bhaalspawn crisis.

entries.name: Echo of Amelyssan
entries.description: Echo of Amelyssan is a ghost of the former high priestess of Bhaal. She was the main antagonist of Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal.

entries.name: Echo of Illasera
entries.description: Echo of Illasera is a ghost of an elven Bhaalspawn. She was one of the members of the Five during the Bhaalspawn crisis and was the first of them to have been defeated by Gorion's Ward.

entries.name: Echo of Sendai
entries.description: The Echo of Sendai is a ghost of a drow Bhaalspawn. She was one of the members of the Five during the Bhaalspawn crisis.

entries.name: Edenosa
entries.description: Manip Edenosa is a gnome cleric, a Manip of the Flaming Fist and a True Soul. She can found in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Edmundis Magarus
entries.description: Edmundis Magarus is a halfling employee of the Circus of the Last Days found in Rivington, right before the entrance to the circus area.

entries.name: Edowin
entries.description: Edowin is a True Soul of the Absolute. He was searching the Wilderness with  Andrick and  Brynna for survivors of the Nautiloid Wreck to locate a weapon.

entries.name: Edvidge
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Edvidge is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Edwynna
entries.description: Gauntlet Edwynna is a human cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist. She guards the South Span Checkpoint between Rivington and Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Eef
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Eef is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Eefa Barlow
entries.description: Eefa Barlow is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Efrin Hammerborn
entries.description: Efrin is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims. He is in a  petrified state in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel near the Blinded Elf.

entries.name: Eglantine
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Eglantine is a human member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Eight
entries.description: Eight is a goblin child in the Goblin Camp.

entries.name: Elda (Flaming Fist)
entries.description: Fist Elda is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Elda (Night Blade)
entries.description: Night Blade Elda is a human Night Blade who can be found at the Bhaal Temple in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Elder Rothé
entries.description: The Elder Rothé is in Grymforge during Act One. It can be spoken to using  Speak with Animals.

entries.name: Eldra Luthrinn
entries.description: Eldra Luthrinnn is a gold dwarven Barbarian. As a hireling, she can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Eleganza
entries.description: Saer Eleganza appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Elegis
entries.description: Elegis is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She becomes responsible for closing and opening the gate to the grove after  Kanon's untimely demise.

entries.name: Elenna Thrinn
entries.description: Sergeant Thrinn is a duergar cultist at Grymforge in Act One. She has tasked several duergar to retrieve her stolen boots.

entries.name: Elias Fischer
entries.description: Elias Fischer is a grieving father in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Elifer
entries.description: Harper Elifer is a wood elf ranger who is part of the Harpers in Act Two. She guards the entrance to the Last Light Inn, stopping and questioning any newcomers that happen to arrive in front of the sanctuary.

entries.name: Elin
entries.description: Blaze Elin is a human wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is at Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Ellice
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Ellice is a human member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Ellie
entries.description: Ellie, named in-game as Dead Fisher, was a fisher who died on the Ravaged Beach in Act One.

entries.name: Elliot
entries.description: Elliot is a member of the Guild.

entries.name: Ellswort
entries.description: Ellswort is a deceased Gnome in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Ellyka
entries.description: Ellyka is a scout near the Mountain Pass entrance to the west of Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Elminster
entries.description: Elminster Aumar, commonly known as Elminster, is a legendary wizard who appears in Baldur's Gate 3. He is one of the current Chosen of the Goddess  Mystra and plays a key recurring role in the story of  Gale. He is first encountered under the name Weary Traveller.

entries.name: Elsa
entries.description: Elsa is a human child in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Elthira Gossen
entries.description: Fist Elthira Gossen is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Elwyn
entries.description: Elwyn is a human druid in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Elyna
entries.description: Elyna is a Rock Gnome in the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington. She is working in the off-limits dressing room area.

entries.name: Embry
entries.description: Embry is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Emmeline Hallowleaf
entries.description: Emmeline Hallowleaf is a Human  Selûnite and the mother of  Shadowheart. She can potentially become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Emmet
entries.description: Emmet is a human civilian visiting the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Eni
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Eni is a human Death's Head of Bhaal.

entries.name: Enris Kellem
entries.description: Enris Kellem is a dead wood elf whose corpse is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Entharl Danthelon
entries.description: Entharl Danthelon is the owner of Danthelon's Dancing Axe in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Enver Gortash
entries.description:
Lord Enver Gortash, often just referred to as Gortash, is the Chosen of  Bane, and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute. He serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.
Despite his humble beginnings, Gortash quickly rose through the ranks of society in Baldur's Gate with unbridled ambition and great cunning. Now, an influential figure and poised to become the Archduke of the city, he seeks to consolidate his power and become the ruler of the city and beyond, through whatever means are necessary.

entries.name: Ephren
entries.description: Fist Recruit Ephren is a human fighter and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. She is on the Risen Road in Act One.

entries.name: Equidna
entries.description: Fist Equidna is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Eramas
entries.description: Eramas is one of the tiefling refugees sheltering at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She is packing her belongings by the entrance to the Makeshift Prison.

entries.name: Ermlaut
entries.description: Ermlaut is one of the audience members at the show in front of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Erna
entries.description: Erna is a member of the Zhentarim who guards  Roah Moonglow alongside  Yerle in the Shattered Sanctum and Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Ernestus
entries.description: Fist Ernestus is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Errant Soul
entries.description: Errant Souls spawn randomly for a few seconds in the House of Hope in Act Three.

entries.name: Erus
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Erus is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Eshvelt Guthmere
entries.description: Lady Eshvelt Guthmere is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Essius
entries.description: Harper Essius is a confident Harper at the Last Light Inn in Act Two. Depending on party choices in Act Two, he assists the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Esther
entries.description: Lady Esther is a member of the Society of Brilliance. She is on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail during Act One.

entries.name: Estra Stir
entries.description: Estra Stir is a gossip columnist for a newspaper in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Eternal Rat
entries.description: Eternal Rat is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Ettvard Needle
entries.description: Ettvard Needle is the human editor in chief for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. He is in the main building, the Baldur's Mouth, in the Lower City.

entries.name: Eugenie Kenridge
entries.description: Eugenie Kenridge is on an outing with her partner at Bloomridge Park in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Exxvikyap
entries.description: Exxvikyap is a brass dragonborn trader in Rivington during Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Fairwise
entries.description: Doctor Fairwise is a high half-elf follower of Umberlee, in Act Three.

entries.name: Falael
entries.description: Falael is a delivery worker for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette, outside the Baldur's Mouth building in the Lower City.

entries.name: Falcäo
entries.description: Manip Falcäo is a human  fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Falla
entries.description: Zealot Falla guards the eastern side of the Moonrise Towers throne room in Act Two.

entries.name: Fallen Champion
entries.description: A Fallen Champion is an undead skeleton creature in Act Three.

entries.name: Fallen Fighter
entries.description: A Fallen Fighter is an undead skeleton creature in Act Three.

entries.name: Fallen Ranger
entries.description: A Fallen Ranger is an undead skeleton creature only found in Act Three.

entries.name: Fallen Wizard
entries.description: A Fallen Wizard is an undead skeleton creature only found in Act Three.

entries.name: Falten
entries.description: Waiter Falten is an employee of Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Falura
entries.description: Falura the Sous-Chef is a halfling employee to  Lady Jannath who can potentially be encountered in the kitchen of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Fank
entries.description: Fank is an ogre in the Blighted Village during Act One.

entries.name: Faona
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Faona is a human member of the Cashguard, in the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Far'aag
entries.description: Gish Far'aag is a githyanki gish who guards the entryway to Crèche Y'llek. Anyone seeking passage into the crèche's must first convince her to let them through.

entries.name: Faril
entries.description: Cashguard Captain Faril is the captain of the Counting House's Cashguard.

entries.name: Farimorn
entries.description: Pilgrim Farimorn is a half-elf in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Farlin
entries.description: Farlin is a member of the Guild and envoy of  Nine-Fingers Keene.

entries.name: Featherweight Falson
entries.description: Featherweight Falson is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Feena
entries.description: Arbiter Feena is a cambion in service of the Archdevil  Zariel, working closely with  Mizora.

entries.name: Felgi Diggums
entries.description: Felgi Diggums is attempting to make deliveries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Felix Farrahd
entries.description: Felix Farrahd is a dead human in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Fentamia Viney
entries.description: Fentamia Viney is in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Feona
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Feona is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Ferg Drogher
entries.description: Ferg Drogher is a human trader encountered in Act Three. He is an opportunist looking to make gold off the crisis in Rivington, buying heirlooms from desperate refugees in need of gold and selling their goods elsewhere with his shadowy supplier.

entries.name: Fernhollow
entries.description: Fist Fernhollow is a halfling fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Ferr
entries.description: Ferr is a named worg in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Fevrokis
entries.description: Fevrokis is a tiefling child who is distraught after finding the bodies of his dead parents in the Brampton district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Fezk
entries.description: Tracker Fezk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Fezzerk
entries.description: Fezzerk leads a gang of goblins at Blighted Village in Act One, tormenting an unfortunate deep gnome as part of the  ⁠Rescue the Gnome quest. Depending on whether he is spared, he can make a minor appearance in Act Two.

entries.name: Ffion Goldgrind
entries.description: Ffion Goldgrind is a dead Dwarf whose corpse is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Fig
entries.description: Fig is a human child in the  Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Figaro Pennygood
entries.description: Figaro 'Facemaker' Pennygood is a merchant who owns the store Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City in Act Three. He is the brother of  Carmen Pennygood, the owner of Carm's Garms in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Fillip
entries.description: Gardener Fillip is a lightfoot halfling civilian waiting in a queue in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Filro
entries.description: Filro the Forgotten is a hostile male drow wizard located in the Dread Hollow area of the Underdark.

entries.name: Filson Vago
entries.description: Filson Vago is a human civilian. He appears to be lost and is near the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Findal
entries.description: Findal is a lightfoot halfling who can be found in the Underground Passage in Act One.

entries.name: Fireliia Jannath
entries.description: Lady Fireliia Jannath is a Human in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Fishbait Arno
entries.description: Fishbait Arno is a gnome member of the Zhentarim that can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three.

entries.name: Fist Attacker
entries.description: Fist Attackers are summonable allies during Confront the Elder Brain, using their halberds and formation tactics to protect the city against the Absolutist forces' incursion.

entries.name: Fist of Bane
entries.description: Fists of Bane are the lowest rank of foot soldiers of Bane who obey all orders without hesitation.

entries.name: Fitzy Relma
entries.description: Fitzy Relma is an Untaken of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Five
entries.description: Five is a goblin child in the Goblin Camp.

entries.name: Flaerith
entries.description: Flaerith is a half-elf wine merchant. She is at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Flaheerta
entries.description: Flaheerta is a half-elf civilian. She is walking around the fish market in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Flaming Fist Wizard
entries.description: Flaming Fist Wizards are wizards of the Flaming Fist that can be found guarding and patrolling the streets of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Flaming Pete
entries.description: Flaming Pete, disguised as a Tipplesome Patron, is a Redcap Boatswain in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Flan Hawser
entries.description: Seawind Flan Hawser is a Savage Seawind of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Flansy Thornwhist
entries.description: Flansy Thornwhist is a lightfoot halfling member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Fleer
entries.description: Fleer is a fisher in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Fleiner
entries.description: Saer Fleiner is a dwarven civilian waiting in a queue in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Flesh
entries.description: Flesh is a flesh golem, a construct creature in Baldur's Gate 3. It is found in the Gauntlet of Shar, working as a servant for  Balthazar.

entries.name: Flimsy
entries.description: Flimsy is a rock gnome commoner. He is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Flind
entries.description: Flind is a hostile gnoll warlord in The Risen Road Cave just west of The Risen Road Waypoint during Act One.

entries.name: Flinster Sunseeker
entries.description: Flinster Sunseeker is a corpse in the crypt underneath the Open Hand Temple in Rivington. He is raised as a Greater Zombie, if the party refuses to take the curse from the  Sentient Amulet (Rare).

entries.name: Flo Hurlburl
entries.description: Flo Hurlburl is concerned about the dangers of using Steel Watchers in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Flo-Flo
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Flo-Flo is a member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Florean Bixworth
entries.description: Florean Bixworth is being interrogated in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Floridor
entries.description: Floridor is a rock gnome guest of the Guild near the bar in the Guildhall within the Undercity.

entries.name: Florrick
entries.description: Counsellor Florrick is an  elven  wizard and advisor to the Archduke. Her loyalty to  Grand Duke Ravengard is beyond question. Steady as Tyr's heartbeat, as upstanding as the Sword Mountains, Florrick plays a notable role in the politics brewing within Baldur's Gate, mainly through the questline ⁠Rescue the Grand Duke.

entries.name: Flytebon
entries.description: Lady Flytebon is a dwarven noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Foharell
entries.description: Captain Foharell is a dwarf follower of Umberlee in Act Three.

entries.name: Follgast
entries.description: Follgast is an elven member of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three.

entries.name: Fonmara
entries.description: Mind Master Fonmara is a duergar who can be found at Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: For'reth
entries.description: Gish For'reth is on the Mountain Pass during Act One.

entries.name: Forstum
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Forstum is a human member of the Cashguard, in the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Fortuno Dibbs
entries.description: Fortuno Dibbs is a Human refugee in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Four
entries.description: Four is a goblin child in the Goblin Camp.

entries.name: Franc Peartree
entries.description: Franc Peartree is a Baldur's Gate citizen. He was working as a cook in Basilisk Gate Barracks in Lower City. By the time party reach the Act Three locations, Peartree (if encountered) is already dead.

entries.name: Franchot
entries.description: Sister Franchot is in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Francis
entries.description: Francis, named in-game as Abducted Nobleman, can be found in the Nautiloid Wreck during Act One.

entries.name: Fred
entries.description: Fred is a Redcap in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Freddo
entries.description: Harper Freddo is a lightfoot halfling druid and a member of the Harpers in Act Three. He joins  Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge, should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage.

entries.name: Fredrichk
entries.description: Sentry Fredrichk is a follower of Shar.

entries.name: Freida Oberon
entries.description: Lady Freida Oberon is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Frell Olsin
entries.description: Frell Olsin is a human member of the Church of Gond, found enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Frenello
entries.description: Saer Frenello is a patron of the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Frightened Ox
entries.description: Frightened Ox is an ox which can be found near the entrance to the Zhentarim Basement at Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Friol
entries.description: Boss Friol is the Rock Gnome leader of the Zhentarim found in Act Three, if  Roah Moonglow had been killed earlier in the game.

entries.name: Frode
entries.description: Fist of Bane Frode is a human cultist of Bane in the Steel Watch Foundry next to  Fist of Bane Gudrun.

entries.name: Fry
entries.description: Watchman Fry is a member of the City Watch in the Upper City in Act Three. He attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute.

entries.name: Fuffi Fuffers
entries.description: Fuffi Fuffers is an Ironhand gnome in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Fulguro
entries.description: Ironshield Brounce is an Ironhand gnome in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Funglesby
entries.description: Funglesby is a follower of the Stone Lord.

entries.name: Furbleston
entries.description: Furbleston is a halfling servant to  Lady Jannath who can be encountered in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Furek
entries.description: Adept Furek is a drow Adept of the Absolute in Moonrise Towers during Act Two. He is stationed outside the main throne room, alongside  Adept Dorikel.

entries.name: Fuschia Vineshoot
entries.description: Fuschia Vineshoot is in front of the Singing Lute in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Fustian
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Fustian is a human Death's Head of Bhaal.

entries.name: Fyodor
entries.description: Fyodor is a bugbear who works at the Circus of the Last Days as a bouncer in Rivington, during Act Three.

entries.name: Fyrd Nuugh
entries.description: Fyrd Nuugh is a half-orc food merchant. He is conversing with  Beulla Sandfoot on a pier gazebo outside of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Fytz
entries.description: Fytz the Firecracker is a weapons trader in the Lower City in Act Three. She is also an old friend of  Karlach.

entries.name: G'imre
entries.description: High Gish'ra G'imre is a githyanki character encountered in the Astral Plane at the end of Act Two. He is part of  Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him.

entries.name: G'nuril
entries.description: Ardent G'nuril is a githyanki ardent in Crèche Y'llek during Act One. She is Kith'rak Therezzyn's guard and associate.

entries.name: G'r'ath
entries.description: Raider G'r'ath is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Gable
entries.description: Gable is a human child. He wants to visit the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Gaff Garsem
entries.description: Gaff Garsem is a human civilian attempting to hunt ghosts in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gaheid Slickjaw
entries.description: Gaheid Slickjaw is a dragonborn close to the well opposite of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Gai
entries.description: Fist Gai is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is at Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Gald
entries.description: Sapper Gald is a goblin sapper in Act One.

entries.name: Gale
entries.description:
Gale Dekarios is an Origin Character and recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a human wizard with the Sage background. Gale can be first found at the Roadside Cliffs waypoint during Act One.
A scholar and prodigy in the arcane arts, Gale is committed to unlocking the secrets of the Weave no matter the cost.

entries.name: Galem Meats
entries.description: Galem Meats is a half-orc smuggler who is part of  Big Huido's gang during Act Three.

entries.name: Galleass
entries.description: Cashguard Galleass is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Gan
entries.description: Gan is one of the tiefling refugees sheltering at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Gandrel
entries.description: Gandrel is a human Gur monster-hunter who is southwest of the Riverside Teahouse waypoint in Act One. He arrived in the Sunlit Wetlands to ask  Auntie Ethel for help with his current hunt.

entries.name: Gannet
entries.description: Bosun Gannet is a human who serves food and drinks in the Blushing Mermaid tavern in Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Garias
entries.description: Garias is a human guard in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Garithon
entries.description: Night Blade Garithon is a human Night Blade in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Garmin
entries.description: Iron Consul Garmin is a cultist of  Bane and one of  Gortash's bodyguards.

entries.name: Garmor
entries.description: Novice Garmor is part of  Gekh Coal's search crew in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Garret Dortmell
entries.description: Garret Dortmell is  Nina's deceased brother.

entries.name: Garrett
entries.description: Garrett is a human refugee in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Garrigan
entries.description: Garrigan is a Sharran Novice within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Garron Flintsplitter
entries.description: Garron Flintsplitter is a Dwarf in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Gasper Throaks
entries.description: Fist of Bane Gasper Throaks is a cultist of Bane and son of  Blarson and  Clovia Throaks.

entries.name: Geanne
entries.description: Sister Geanne is an undead nurse in the town of Reithwin during Act Two.

entries.name: Gekh Coal
entries.description: Gekh Coal leads a group of duergar slavers in the Decrepit Village in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Genshu Ofran
entries.description: Genshu Ofran is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond. He is enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Geraldus
entries.description: Geraldus is a new recruit for the Harpers, who has been looking into the recent Bhaalist activity in the city on  Jaheira's orders. He is in Danthelon's Dancing Axe in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Gergerann
entries.description: Stonemason Gergerann is inspecting the stonework of Grymforge in Act One.

entries.name: Gerringothe Thorm
entries.description: Gerringothe Thorm is a unique intelligent Undead, the toll-master of the Reithwin Tollhouse.

entries.name: Gerson
entries.description: Gerson the Bent is a tiefling at the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Gethin
entries.description: Gethin is a is a human member of a local militia in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Gha'an
entries.description: Gha'an is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Ghainemeir
entries.description: Fist Ghainemeir is a human member of the Flaming Fist visiting Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing. He makes sexual advances towards  Irenya while slightly drunk.

entries.name: Gheris Hhune
entries.description: Gheris Hhune is a Werewolf in the ballroom of Cazador Szarr's palace.

entries.name: Gherva Minedale
entries.description: Gherva Minedale is a dwarven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Ghik'lir
entries.description: High Gish'ra Ghik'lir is a githyanki character encountered at the Wyrm's Crossing campsite at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: Ghislev
entries.description: Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev, also referred to as Farslayer Ghislev, is a character who can be encountered in the Undercity Ruins area of Baldur's Gate 3, during Act Three.

entries.name: Ghulen
entries.description: Adept Ghulen guards the stairs leading up to the ground floor's main hall of Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two.

entries.name: Ghush'ins
entries.description: Veteran Gish Ghush'ins is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Giant Eagle (creature)
entries.description: A Giant Eagle is a large beast creature that can be encountered during Act One of Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Giftu Hudd
entries.description: Giftu Hudd travelled to Baldur's Gate with two companions during Act Three.

entries.name: Gimblebock
entries.description: Gimblebock is a gnome bandit leader looting the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Gipkins Jared
entries.description: Gipkins Jared is an Ironhand gnome in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Gira
entries.description: Gira is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, who can be found in Act Three in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Gizelle Flintsplitter
entries.description: Gizelle Flintsplitter is a Dwarf in the Rivington refuge camp.

entries.name: Gleeful Clong
entries.description: Gleeful Clong is a member of  Zenovia's gang and member of The Guild. He is outside  Arfur Gregorio's mansion in Rivington.

entries.name: Glimmer Whistleborn
entries.description: Glimmer Whistleborn is a reporter for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. She is inside the Baldur's Mouth building in the Lower City.

entries.name: Glingo
entries.description: Glingo Trapeze-Master is a human Bard at the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Glist
entries.description: Harper Glist is a human ranger and a member of the Harpers in Act Three. He joins  Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge, should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage.

entries.name: Glomp
entries.description: Glomp the looter scavenges the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Glone
entries.description: Glone is an Untaken of Umberlee, found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gloommask
