entries.description: Gloommask is a Sharran Fidelian within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace located at X: -392 Y: -1639.

entries.name: Gloomy Fentonson
entries.description: Gloomy Fentonson is an armour trader at the Stormshore Armoury in Act Three.

entries.name: Gloria
entries.description: Gloria is a human commoner. She is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Glourik
entries.description: Glourik is an ogre in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Glut
entries.description: Sovereign Glut is a Myconid and an Attached Follower. It is the sole survivor of a Duergar attack against its circle, now taking refuge at Ebonlake Grotto, a myconid colony in the Underdark.

entries.name: Glynda Oltower
entries.description: Glynda Oltower is a trader in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Glyria
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Glyria is a human Death's Head of Bhaal.

entries.name: Gnat
entries.description: Booyahg Gnat is a goblin stationed in the Shattered Sanctum during Act One.

entries.name: Gneiss
entries.description: Fist Gneiss is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Godey
entries.description: Godey is an Undead Skeleton in the service of Cazador Szarr.

entries.name: Godfrey Mordels
entries.description: Godfrey Mordels is one of the Gur, the human nomadic tribe. He is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3.

entries.name: Gohumberry Tresp
entries.description: Gohumberry Tresp is a dead Human whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Golbraith Stredivas
entries.description: Golbraith Stredivas is a human who can be encountered on the first floor of his house in the Lower City. He is loosely based on a fan of Baldur's Gate 3, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's.

entries.name: Goldwake
entries.description: Captain Goldwake is a human follower of Umberlee in Act Three.

entries.name: Gomwick
entries.description: Gomwick's corpse is in the Forest, protected by his dog  Scratch in Act One.

entries.name: Gondlemead
entries.description: Gondlemead is an Undead Vampire Spawn imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: Gonfalon
entries.description: Fist Gonfalon is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Goodge
entries.description: Watchman Goodge is a member of the City Watch in the Upper City in Act Three. He attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute.

entries.name: Goosequill
entries.description: Scribe Goosequill is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gor Falogen
entries.description: Gor Falogen is an elven civilian attempting to hunt ghosts in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gordis
entries.description: Gordis is an undead ghost dog in the Durinbold Mausoleum in Baldur's Gate's Lower City.

entries.name: Goris Ballast
entries.description: Goris Ballast is staying in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gorran Penghyst
entries.description: Sir Gorran Penghyst is a human noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Gothric Rillyn
entries.description: Gothric Rillyn is a human who has been buried alive in a plot at the Lower City graveyard during Act 3.

entries.name: Gowlan
entries.description: Gowlan is a fisher in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Goxxoon
entries.description: Goxxoon is a dead blue dragonborn whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Grace Flamm
entries.description: Grace Flamm is a human civilian waiting in a queue in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gracie Scyre
entries.description: Mortarch Gracie Scyre is a human cleric in the Graveyard in Baldur's Gate 3. She is a devotee of Kelemvor and manages the graveyard.

entries.name: Granitdatter
entries.description: Fist Granitdatter is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Grat
entries.description: Grat the Trader is a goblin trader in Act One.

entries.name: Gravedigger Karcen
entries.description: Gravedigger Karcen is a human fighter and Zhentarim mercenary that can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three. He guards and patrols the southern half of the Guildhall in the event of a possible  Stone Lord attack.

entries.name: Greenfern
entries.description: Greenfern is a Wood Half-Elf servant of the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Greez
entries.description: Warlock Greez is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Gregory Bright
entries.description: Gregory Bright is a Halfling in the Rivington refugee camp.

entries.name: Gresh
entries.description: Warrior Gresh is a Goblin Warrior in the Underground Passage in Act One. He leads a small group of scouts who are holding  Findal hostage.

entries.name: Gretta
entries.description: Gretta is a Flaming Fist under the command of  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.

entries.name: Greymask
entries.description: Greymask is a Sharran Novice within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Greymon
entries.description: Corsair Greymon is a duergar trader. He is on a skiff and later moves to Grymforge.

entries.name: Greyward
entries.description: Greyward is a Black Gauntlet of Bane.

entries.name: Gribbo
entries.description: Gribbo is a goblin in the Goblin Camp during Act One. She is the proud owner of her new 'pigeon': the writer  Volo.

entries.name: Grice
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Grice is a member of the Cult of Bhaal. She is in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Griff
entries.description: Fist Griff is a human ranger, a member of the Flaming Fist and a True Soul. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Grikka
entries.description: Tracker Grikka is in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Grimlark
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Grimlark is a human follower of Bhaal found in the Bhaal Temple in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate. He is the assumed author of Murder, Be My Muse and the Grimlark Verses.

entries.name: Grindo Biggs
entries.description: Grindo Biggs is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, found enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Griska
entries.description: Traveller Griska is a tiefling trader at Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Grisselda Dibbs
entries.description: Grisselda Dibbs is a Human refugee in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Gronag
entries.description: Warrior Gronag is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two.

entries.name: Gronch
entries.description: Gronch is a Half-orc in the Rivington refugee camp at X: 86 Y: -79. He was traveling with Gregory and Nealos Bright.

entries.name: Grotpoll
entries.description: Saer Grotpoll is a high elven character, a Baldurian in Act Three.

entries.name: Grout
entries.description: Grout is a forest gnome on a stroll along the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City.

entries.name: Grub
entries.description: Grub is a medium haired red Cat with blue eyes in Rivington.

entries.name: Grukkoh
entries.description: Grukkoh is a bugbear in Act One. He can be found in the Forest, north of the Blighted Village with his companion  Buthir.

entries.name: Grumm
entries.description: Grumm is a special replacement character in the Grymforge who takes control of the gnome slaves. Grumm appears only if the party side with  Nere and both Nere and  Thrinn die during the munity against Nere.

entries.name: Grundlgornn
entries.description: Grundlgornn is a dwarven civilian who is listening to  Umbrenne, a prophet of  Talona in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Grundril
entries.description: Grundril is a duergar ranger at Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Gruntman
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Gruntman is a member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Grush
entries.description: Lookout Grush is a goblin stationed at the Shattered Sanctum in Act One. He and  Torturer Spike are interrogating  Liam next to the Bloodied Shrine.

entries.name: Gruz
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Gruz is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Grym
entries.description: Grym is a powerful adamantine golem that eternally protects the Adamantine Forge. It cannot be damaged without becoming  Superheated first.

entries.name: Guex
entries.description: Guex is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is usually on the training grounds, where he is practising his combat skills.

entries.name: Gulster Boyes
entries.description: Gulster Boyes is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gummidge
entries.description: Fist Gummidge is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Gur Hunter Sharpshooter
entries.description: Gur Hunter Sharpshooter is a ranger archetype of Gur.

entries.name: Gur Hunter Warrior (Handaxe)
entries.description: Gur Hunter Warrior is a summonable ally during Confront the Elder Brain if the party kills Cazador.

entries.name: Gur Hunter Warrior (Scimitar)
entries.description: Gur Hunter Warrior is a summonable ally during Confront the Elder Brain if the party kills Cazador.

entries.name: Gurd
entries.description: Brawler Gurd is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Gurgon
entries.description: Guard Gurgon is an ogre in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Gurira
entries.description: Cashguard Gurira is a member of the Cashguard for the Counting House in the Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Gurk
entries.description: Warlock Gurk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Gurza
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Gurza is a goblin sharp-eye in the Underground Passage during Act One. She and her fellow goblins have captured  Findal.

entries.name: Gustav
entries.description: Gustav is a courier dog employed by  Angry Mar'hyah at the Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Gut
entries.description: Priestess Gut, also known as True Soul Gut, is a goblin True Soul and follower of The Absolute stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Gydd
entries.description: Gydd is a Sharran Fidelian within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace located at X: -395 Y: -1662.

entries.name: Gyldro Angleiron
entries.description: Gyldro Angleiron is a human blacksmith who owns the Rivington General in Rivington.

entries.name: Gyordi
entries.description: Watchman Gyordi is a member of the City Watch in the Upper City in Act Three. He attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute.

entries.name: Haarlep
entries.description: Haarlep is an Incubus in the House of Hope. Employed by  Raphael to satisfy his desires, they are in Raphael's personal chambers. Haarlep can be engaged with, in which case they will provide valuable information in exchange for a fiendish sexual encounter. Alternatively, they can be fought, skipping the sexual encounter but losing access to the information.

entries.name: Hadenwell
entries.description: Fist Hadenwell is a human Flaming Fist in Act Two. He can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Haeril Birch
entries.description: Lady Haeril Birch is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Enver Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Hagedorrn
entries.description: Fist Hagedorrn is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Hahns Rives
entries.description: Hahns Rives is a Black Gauntlet of Bane who oversees the Steel Watch Foundry's underground lab area. He is at X: -1957 Y: 454.

entries.name: Hairy Henry
entries.description: Hairy Henry is a member of the Cult of Myrkul in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony.

entries.name: Hakeem
entries.description: Hakeem is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Halantow
entries.description: Fist Halantow is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Halsin
entries.description:
Halsin is a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a wood elf and a Circle of the Moon Druid with the Outlander background. Halsin can first be found in the Shattered Sanctum during Act One as an attached follower or as a camp follower.
Halsin seeks to create a harmonious balance between nature and civilisation as well as find a cure for the Shadow Curse that has haunted his home for the past century.

entries.name: Hamate
entries.description: Hamate is a ghoul in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Hangfar
entries.description: Harper Hangfar is a Harper who patrols the northern side of Last Light Inn during Act Two.

entries.name: Hans Feather
entries.description: Hans Feather is a half-elven guest of The Guild who is near the bar in the Guildhall within the Undercity.

entries.name: Hapdim
entries.description: Hapdim is an Undead Vampire Spawn imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: Happy Hands
entries.description: Happy Hands is a member of the Guild.

entries.name: Happy Hoarson
entries.description: Happy Hoarson is an NPC in Baldur's Gate 3. He's found at the party site during the Epilogue

entries.name: Har'rak
entries.description: Ch'r'ai Har'rak is a githyanki paladin in Knights of the Shield Hideout in Act Three. She has been sent by  Vlaakith to learn more about the mysterious Emperor.

entries.name: Hara
entries.description: Courier Hara is a human civilian in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three. He is being detained and "evaluated" by a Steel Watcher.

entries.name: Harfang
entries.description: Harfang is a dead sailor on a ship in Act Three.

entries.name: Hari Nodles
entries.description: Hari Nodles is a human civilian. He is attempting to comfort  Fevrokis after he found the bodies of his dead parents in the Brampton district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Harissa Chopeta
entries.description: Harissa Chopeta is a human civilian behind the Elfsong Tavern, hoping to receive leftovers from  Spatula Farggo during Act Three.

entries.name: Harper Archer
entries.description: Harper Archers are summonable, failsafe allies that provide ranged support in Act Three.

entries.name: Hartlebury
entries.description: Fist Wizard Hartlebury is a dwarven wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Harvard Willoughby
entries.description: Harvard Willoughby is a human comedian at the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Haseid
entries.description: Haseid is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Hastar Biggs
entries.description: Hastar Biggs is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Havard
entries.description: Fist Havard is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the streets of Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Havkelaag
entries.description: Havkelaag is a member of the Society of Brilliance in the Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3. He can be found at The Lodge in Act Three.

entries.name: He Who Was
entries.description: He Who Was is a shadar-kai on the Ruined Battlefield at X: 129 Y: 106. He gives the quest Punish the Wicked and has a  Raven companion.

entries.name: Hector Roba
entries.description: Hector Roba is an upset halfling customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Heder Cross
entries.description: Heder Cross is a human child gawking at the elementals inside the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Heen
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Heen is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Helag
entries.description: Raider Helag is a githyanki raider in Crèche Y’llek in Act One.

entries.name: Helena
entries.description: Fist Helena is a rock gnome Flaming Fist in Act Two. She can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Helena Anchev
entries.description: Helena Anchev, also known as Orin's Mother Helena, is the daughter of  Sarevok Anchev and both the mother and half-sister to  Orin the Red, the latter of whom was born through an incestuous relationship between Sarevok and Helena.

entries.name: Helenia
entries.description: Cashguard Helenia is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Hellrider Cleric
entries.description: The Hellrider Cleric is a summonable ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain, if ⁠Zevlor survives Act One and Act Two.

entries.name: Hellrider Paladin
entries.description: The Hellrider Paladin is a summonable ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain, if  Zevlor survives Act One and Act Two.

entries.name: Helsik
entries.description: Helsik is a diabolist who owns the Devil's Fee in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three. She trades in magical equipment, alchemy ingredients, dyes, potions, and scrolls. As a diabolist, Helsik can also open a portal to the Hells.

entries.name: Hendly
entries.description: Hendly is a Sharran Sentry in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Henk
entries.description: Tender Henk is the owner of The Singing Lute, a restaurant in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Hertvor Dremble
entries.description: Guard Hertvor Dremble is a human guard in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Hervyl
entries.description: Night Blade Hervyl is a human Night Blade in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Hextra
entries.description: Fist Hextra is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Hiero Lue
entries.description: Hiero Lue is a member of the Dead Eyes, a bandit group which might be found in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Hiila
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Hiila is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Hilario Varota
entries.description: Hilario Varota is in Baldur's Gate during Act Three, discussing the gorier aspects of a recent murder case.

entries.name: Hildeh
entries.description: High-Wire Hildeh is a high elf performer at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three.

entries.name: His Majesty
entries.description: His Majesty is a hairless ⁠Sphynx cat with blue eyes in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

entries.name: Hivune
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Hivune is a human follower of Bhaal.

entries.name: Hoarding Merregon
entries.description: Hoarding Merregon is a Merregon and trader that dwells in Yurgir's chamber in the Gauntlet of Shar. It serves as the Orthon's quartermaster.

entries.name: Hogi Nuners
entries.description: Hogi Nuners is a Deep Gnome member of Clan Ironhand.

entries.name: Holli Dylford
entries.description: Holli Dylford is a deceased human, found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Holvik
entries.description: Holvik is one of the duergar accompanying  Gekh Coal to the Decrepit Village in Act One.

entries.name: Honest Vendor
entries.description: Honest Vendor is a trader in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Honk
entries.description: Tender Honk is a situational character in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, a tender in The Singing Lute restaurant.

entries.name: Hoots Hooligan
entries.description: Hoots Hooligan is a human bartender at Sharess' Caress in Act Three.

entries.name: Hope
entries.description: Hope is a dwarven Cleric and captive of the House of Hope.

entries.name: Horriss
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Horriss is a human follower of Bhaal found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Horst
entries.description: Stylin' Horst is a Trader in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Hr'ack'la
entries.description: Zephyr Gish'ra Hr'ack'la is a githyanki character encountered at the Wyrm's Crossing campsite at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: Hubersa Declensios
entries.description: Hubersa Declensios is a dead human whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Huido
entries.description: Big Huido is a smuggler waiting for a pick-up from The Guild at Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Huk
entries.description: Warrior Huk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Humbletoes
entries.description: Vicar Humbletoes is the guardian of the Stormshore Tabernacle and a merchant whom party members can trade with.

entries.name: Humboldt
entries.description: Humboldt is a Sharran Novice within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Humgoole
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Humgoole is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Hungry Ox
entries.description: Hungry Ox is an ox in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Hunna
entries.description: Sister Hunna is an undead nurse in the House of Healing, situated in the town of Reithwin, during Act Two.

entries.name: Hurk
entries.description: Hurk is a duergar ranger who is a part of  Corsair Greymon's crew in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Hyena (Shadow-Cursed Lands)
entries.description: Hyena is an unnamed hyena travelling with a caravan of Absolutists in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

entries.name: Hyrald
entries.description: Hyrald is a Sharran Fidelian within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace at X: -375 Y: -1639.

entries.name: Hyrla Sname
entries.description: Hyrla Sname is a human civilian who may appear near Bonecloak's Apothecary in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Hyrriet
entries.description: Fist of Bane Hyrriet is a human in Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Iados Kallista
entries.description: Iados Kallista is a Tiefling child. He is begging for food with his family outside the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Ide
entries.description: Ide is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Ifran
entries.description: Ifran is a Black Gauntlet of Bane in the Lower City.

entries.name: Ignur
entries.description: Ignur is a Black Gauntlet of Bane in Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

entries.name: Ikaron
entries.description: Ikaron is a guard for the tiefling refugees at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is responsible for maintaining order and preventing crime within the refugees' group.

entries.name: Immortal Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Immortal Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to Raphael.

entries.name: Imprudence
entries.description: Imprudence is a Human in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She is near the Grey Harbour Docks, as part of  Churg Elvek's mob, ready to bring  Volo to "justice".

entries.name: Impurto Nexim
entries.description: Impurto Nexim is a halfling noble that can potentially be found in the kitchen of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Imwise
entries.description: Imwise is a Sharran Sentry in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Incontinentia Figgin
entries.description: Incontinentia Figgin is a dead Drow whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Indora Ralston
entries.description: Indora Ralston is a Black Gauntlet of Bane in the Lower City.

entries.name: Indra
entries.description: Indra is one of the wolves in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Inessa
entries.description: Sister Inessa is an Undead Nurse in Reithwin during Act Two.

entries.name: Infernal Mason
entries.description:
Morfred, or Infernal Mason, is one of many infernal debtors stuck at the House of Hope after making a deal with  Raphael. He can be found cleaning and generally pottering around the House's feast hall.
The party can ask the Mason for information about the House, but he will give only vague answers in reply. He will, however, reveal that he is the architect of Moonrise Towers, and the party will have the opportunity to tell him the state of his creation and the surrounding shadow-cursed lands.

entries.name: Ingram
entries.description: Fist Ingram is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He moves about the streets of Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Inku Neza
entries.description: Inku Neza is a dragonborn member of the Dead Eyes, a bandit group in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Inocente Bramm
entries.description: Guard Inocente Bramm is a human guard in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Intelligent Sentinel
entries.description: The Intelligent Sentinel is a unique type of Undead guarding the secret shrine to Shar underneath statue of Ketheric Thorm in Reithwin Town's square. Its abilities mirror that of a Wizard, and fitting of its role it has very high Intelligence.

entries.name: Invoker of Bhaal
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal are human members of the Cult of Bhaal and are found throughout the Bhaal Temple and other areas of Act Three.

entries.name: Inwe
entries.description: Inwe is a Wood Elf in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Iogar
entries.description: Zealot Iogar is resting in the barracks west of the ground floor in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Iong
entries.description: Pilgrim Iong is a human in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Irenya
entries.description: Irenya is an Elven waitress for a bar in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Iron Consul of Bane
entries.description: Iron Consuls are cunning field officers who excel at coordinating the Fists of Bane in combat.

entries.name: Ironfinger
entries.description: Ironfinger is a member of the Cult of Myrkul. She is in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony.

entries.name: Ironhand Grenadier
entries.description: Ironhand Grenadier is a summonable ally during Confront the Elder Brain if the party completes Avenge the Ironhands.

entries.name: Isaan Thibault
entries.description: Isaan Thibault is a dead Drow whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Isbeth
entries.description: Isbeth is one of the wolves in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Isobel
entries.description: Isobel is a half-elf and cleric of  Selûne, who protects the Last Light Inn in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. She can also become a Camp Follower.

entries.name: Istor
entries.description: Istor is one of the wolves in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Itchy
entries.description: Itchy is a named Crawling Claw in the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Ith'dul
entries.description: Warrior Ith’dul is at the entrance of Crèche Y’llek before the arrival of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's during Act One.

entries.name: Ito
entries.description: Fist Recruit Ito is a human ranger and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. He is on the Risen Road in Act One.

entries.name: Ivarus
entries.description: Fist Ivarus is human wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Iwan
entries.description: Iwan is a human member of a local militia found in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Iza Blouin
entries.description: Iza Blouin is a sceptical reader of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette during Act Three.

entries.name: Izwae
entries.description: Izwae is a petrified drow ranger in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: J'ehlar
entries.description: Fist J'ehlar is a Flaming Fist who aids  Art Cullagh at Last Light Inn during Act Two. She asks the party to Wake up Art Cullagh and locate  Duke Ravengard.

entries.name: Jacek
entries.description: Flaming Fist Jacek is a deceased Human Fighter who served the Flaming Fist at Waukeen's Rest.

entries.name: Jacelyn
entries.description: Jacelyn is a high half-elven Sorcerer with the Draconic Bloodline subclass. As a hireling, he can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Jacko
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Jacko is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate

entries.name: Jacob
entries.description: Jacob is a named Skeleton employed in the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Jagic
entries.description: Fist Jagic is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Jaheira
entries.description:
Jaheira is a recruitable companion. She and  Minsc return from both Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn and are the only two recruitable companions who cannot be romanced. She is a high half-elf and a druid with the Soldier background, and can be first found at the Last Light Inn during Act Two.
Having become High Harper in the century since her first adventures, wherein her husband Khalid was killed, Jaheira is deadset on maintaining her Harper network, taking down the Cult of the Absolute, and later reuniting with Minsc, her closest friend. Jaheira is known for her sharp wit and dry humour, and also serves as a mentor figure to the rest of the party.

entries.name: Jaheira (doppelganger)
entries.description: Gozz, disguised as 'Jaheira' in-game, is a  doppelganger pretending to be  Jaheira to fool tadpoled  Minsc into obedience.

entries.name: Janina
entries.description: Janina is a dead human in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Jara
entries.description: Fist Jara is human Flaming Fist patron of Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing. She has a tadpole, and transforms into a Mind flayer upon encountering the party.

entries.name: Jarg
entries.description: Jarg is a human in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Jaryd
entries.description: Jaryd is a lightfoot halfling guard.

entries.name: Jasin
entries.description: Questioner Jasin is charged with interrogating prisoners in Moonrise Towers Prison with  Sumera during Act Two.

entries.name: Jason
entries.description: News Hawker Jason is a human child who sells newspapers in the Lower City square of Baldur's Gate X: -31 Y: -52.

entries.name: Jatlo
entries.description: Jatlo is a redcap disguised as a dragonborn, who resides in Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City. He is a member of the Anti-Hag Support Group.

entries.name: Jaxbock
entries.description: Iron Consul Jaxbock is a cultist of  Bane and one of  Gortash's bodyguards.

entries.name: Jaycen Borgu
entries.description: Jaycen Borgu is a half-orc wine taster. She is at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Jaymes
entries.description: Waiter Jaymes is a staff member in Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

entries.name: Jeera
entries.description: A'jak'nir Jeera is a githyanki trader in Crèche Y'llek.

entries.name: Jeffers Morston
entries.description: Jeffers Morston works with the pigeons at the Sword Coast Couriers Post House in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Jelliwig
entries.description: Jelliwig is a pixie who runs the printing press for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette.

entries.name: Jenniver Antilles
entries.description: Jenniver Antilles is a human. He is on the stairs towards the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Jeorna
entries.description: Jeorna guards the entrance to the Sacred Pool in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Jepsen
entries.description: Fist Jepsen is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Jerris
entries.description: Jerris is a duergar ranger who is a part of  Corsair Greymon's crew in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Jhaam
entries.description: Jhaam, named in-game as Executed Drow, is a dead drow and Harper in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Jhe'rezath
entries.description: Ardent Jhe'rezath is a member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue in Act One.

entries.name: Jheruth
entries.description: Jheruth is a githyanki child who can be found in Act One. She is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y’llek.

entries.name: Jhessem
entries.description: Jhessem is a human child in Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Jimi Borleas
entries.description: Fist Jimi Borleas is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Jitters Corbwell
entries.description: Jitters Corbwell can be found in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Jivin Mizzrym
entries.description: Jivin Mizzrym is a member of the Dead Eyes, a bandit group in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Johl
entries.description: Johl is searching for his sister in the Sunlit Wetlands in Act One.

entries.name: Jonah
entries.description: News Hawker Jonah is a newspaper seller who can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Jord
entries.description: Jord is a half-orc druid in the Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Julia
entries.description: Sister Julia is an Undead Nurse in Reithwin during Act Two.

entries.name: Justen
entries.description: Justen is a deceased member of the Cult of Bhaal, whose corpse can be found in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Justiciar Crusader (archetype)
entries.description: Justiciar Crusader is a generic title and archetype given to powerful warriors who serve Shar.

entries.name: Jy'ir
entries.description: Raider Jy'ir is a githyanki raider in Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Jyd'i'
entries.description: Zephyr Gish'ra Jyd'i' is a githyanki character encountered at the Wyrm's Crossing campsite at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: K'i'lar
entries.description: High Gish'ra K'i'lar is a githyanki character encountered in the Astral Plane at the end of Act Two. She is part of  Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him.

entries.name: Kaet Ling
entries.description: Kaet Ling is a human merchant who can be found negotiating with  Trader Djingo in the Grey Harbour Docks during Act Three.

entries.name: Kagha
entries.description: Kagha is a wood elven druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One. She was Halsin's Second Druid, but has named herself First Druid in his absence. She started the Rite of Thorns to seal the Grove off, no matter the consequences.

entries.name: Kagran
entries.description: Kagran can be found in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Kaldani
entries.description: Kaldani is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She overlooks the area in front of the grove's entrance from atop the gate.

entries.name: Kali Hammerhand
entries.description: Kali Hammerhand is shopping for supplies in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Kameros
entries.description: Cook Kameros is an Asmodeus tiefling in the kitchen at the Basilisk Gate Barracks in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Kanon
entries.description: Kanon was one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He was responsible for opening the gate to the grove but lost his life to a volley of goblin arrows, to his sister Arka's dismay. He can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

entries.name: Kansif
entries.description: Kansif is a stoic and devoted member of the Cult of the Absolute encountered in Act Two.

entries.name: Kar'niss
entries.description: Kar'niss is a drider in service of the Absolute, whom he now serves after being cast out by Lolth, the Queen of Spiders.

entries.name: Karad
entries.description: Karad is one of the human guards patrolling the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Karlach
entries.description:
Karlach Cliffgate is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a Zariel Tiefling and a Barbarian with the Outlander background.  Karlach is on the Risen Road during Act One.
Once a soldier in Zariel's army, Karlach has been given a new chance at life after the recent events. Now, freed from Avernus, she will make the most out of it, and no one will get in her way.
In multiplayer sessions, if Karlach is chosen as an origin by a player,  Wyll is locked out as an option to other players.

entries.name: Karol
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Karol is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Karoline
entries.description: Fist Karoline is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Karrik
entries.description: Karrik is a human druid in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Karrow
entries.description: Harper Karrow is part of a small group of Harpers on a patrol expedition to the hills east of Last Light Inn during Act Two.

entries.name: Kass
entries.description: Kass is an Undead Vampire Spawn who is imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon. She is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by  Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn.

entries.name: Katebee Pol
entries.description: Katebee Pol is a dead blue dragonborn whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Katelyn Lerskin
entries.description: Katelyn Lerskin is one of the Gur, a human nomadic tribe. She is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3.

entries.name: Kavell
entries.description: Servant Kavell is a staff member in Wyrm's Rock Fortress, present at the ceremony of Gortash's ordaining as an Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Kavil
entries.description: Kavil is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She only appears as a replacement character for  Bex during the camp celebration if he is dead.

entries.name: Keren
entries.description: Keren is a monstrosity character in Act Three. Though appearing to be animal tamers for the Circus of the Last Days, Keren and  Ryland are doppelgangers serving  Orin and the Cult of the Absolute.

entries.name: Keris
entries.description: Keris patrols the cells of Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two.

entries.name: Kerz
entries.description: Kerz is a Half-Orc Paladin who swore an Oath of Devotion. As a hireling, they can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Ketheric Thorm
entries.description: General Ketheric Thorm is an Undead with elven ancestry and appearance, the Chosen of  Myrkul, and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute. He serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Kethk
entries.description: Sa'varsh Kethk is an instructor in the Classroom of Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Kettel
entries.description: Mind Master Kettel is a duergar caster who is a part of  Corsair Greymon's crew in the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Kevo Phogge
entries.description: Kevo Phogge is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Abandoned Cistern in the Lower City Sewers during Act Three.

entries.name: Kharyk
entries.description: Raider Kharyk is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Khathi
entries.description: Refugee Khathi is a halfling civilian in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate during in Act Three.

entries.name: Khunaruth
entries.description: Warrior Khunaruth is a githyanki in Crèche Y’llek in Act One.

entries.name: Kimmeral
entries.description: Acolyte Kimmeral is resting in the barracks west of the ground floor in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Kimmy
entries.description: Kimmy is a human child resident of Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Kira
entries.description: Kira the Cat is a medium haired brown cat with blue eyes. She is in Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Kirgrath
entries.description: Kirgrath is a special replacement character in the Grymforge who takes control of the gnome slaves. Kirgrath appears if  Brithvar dies during the mutiny against  Nere.

entries.name: Kirz
entries.description: Tracker Kirz is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Kith
entries.description: Stonemason Kith is a duergar Trader in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Kivak
entries.description: Kivak is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Klaas
entries.description: Fist Klaas is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Klagga
entries.description: Tracker Klagga is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Klank
entries.description: Klank is an animated armour construct that works for  Lorroakan in the city of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Klarrvox
entries.description: Druid Klarrvox is a Dragonborn who is attempting to coax a dying sapling to bloom in Act Three.

entries.name: Klarv
entries.description: Night Blade Klarv is a human Night Blade found in Bloomridge Park in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Klaus
entries.description: Klaus is a wood elf at the Circus of the Last Days. Along with Benji, he is tasked with sniffing people out. If Benji smells blood, they do not allow entrance to the circus.

entries.name: Klaw
entries.description: Klaw is a named worg at the checkpoint just before the Goblin Camp during Act One. She is battle-tested and fierce, and has a litter of pups:  Small Klaw,  Ferr, and  Tale.

entries.name: Kled
entries.description: Kled is a hobgoblin who lives in Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City.

entries.name: Klen
entries.description: Zealot Klen patrols the off-limits area of the first floor in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Klorrvank
entries.description: Klorrvank is a sailor sorting a haul of fish in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Ko'kuu
entries.description: Varsh Ko'kuu is a githyanki charged with the Hatchery of Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Koll (doppelganger)
entries.description: Koll is a Doppelganger found at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. He is disguised as a high-elf wine drinker.

entries.name: Koll (kobold)
entries.description: Koll the Red is a Kobold trader found in the Watch Citadel, an area within the Upper City accessible after travelling to the Morphic Pool.

entries.name: Komira
entries.description: Komira is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Korliss
entries.description: True Soul Korliss is a deceased True Soul of the Cult of the Absolute. Her body is on the Ruined Battlefield surrounded by lit torches in Act Two.

entries.name: Korrilla Hearthflame
entries.description: Korrilla Hearthflame is a gold dwarven agent of  Raphael's. She can be encountered briefly in Act One and Act Two. She later moves to Sharess' Caress, the House of Hope and potentially in the Elfsong Tavern during Act Three.

entries.name: Korrinna Koreena
entries.description: Korrinna Koreena is concerned about Steel Watchers impinging on freedom in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Kramp
entries.description: Warrior Kramp is a goblin raider in Act One.

entries.name: Krank
entries.description: Krank is a construct in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Kravatt
entries.description: Kravatt is a rock gnome civilian waiting in a queue in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Kree Derryck
entries.description: Kree Derryck is a Duergar Warlock who is pact-bound to The Great Old One. As a hireling, she can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Kressa Bonedaughter
entries.description: Kressa Bonedaughter is a member of the Cult of Myrkul in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony.

entries.name: Kristeen Hazel
entries.description: Kristeen Hazel is a Dwarf in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Krizt
entries.description: Zealot Krizt is a Zealot of the Absolute stationed outside Moonrise Towers in Act Two. She guards the side entrance near the Moonrise Towers Docks, vetting new arrivals before they can enter.

entries.name: Krolla
entries.description: Krolla is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One. She is just left of the stage  Volo is performing on, trying to organize a game of chicken chasing. If certain events have played out across the Wilderness, her 'chicken' will instead be the  Owlbear Cub.

entries.name: Krug
entries.description: The body of Krug, named Dead Goblin Raider, is in front of Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Kryss
entries.description: Night Blade Kryss is a dwarven Night Blade who can be found in the Undercity outside the Guildhall in Act Three.

entries.name: Kuo-Toa (creature)
entries.description: Kuo-Toa are a fish-like humanoid creature in The Festering Cove of the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Kur
entries.description: Stone Guard Kur is a duergar ranger who can be found in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Kur'ashk
entries.description: Ardent Kur'ashk is a githyanki ardent in Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Kyberos
entries.description: Fist Kyberos is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Kydden
entries.description: Kydden is a dwarven civilian attempting to hunt ghosts in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Kyr'das
entries.description: Kyr'das is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y’llek during Act One.

entries.name: Kyrr'a'ath
entries.description: Raider Kyrr'a'ath is a member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue during Act One.

entries.name: Lady Ague
entries.description: Lady Ague is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

entries.name: Lady Croup
entries.description: Lady Croup is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

entries.name: Lady Durinbold's Attendant
entries.description: Lady Durinbold's Attendant is a wood elven ranger who accompanies her mistress to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lady Durinbold's Bodyguard is a half-orc battle master fighter who accompanied her mistress to the ordination of  Enver Gortash as the Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lady Flux
entries.description: Lady Flux is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

entries.name: Lady Lockjaw
entries.description: Lady Lockjaw is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

entries.name: Lady Oberon's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lady Oberon's Bodyguard is a dragonborn battle master fighter who accompanies her mistress to the ordination  Enver Gortash as the Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lady Quinsy
entries.description: Lady Quinsy is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

entries.name: Lady Whitburn
entries.description: Lady Whitburn is an unnamed member of the  Whitburn patriar family chatting with  Lord Whitburn outside The Glitter Gala in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Lae'zel
entries.description:
Lae'zel of Crèche K'liir is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a Githyanki Fighter with the Soldier background. Unless played as an origin character, Lae'zel is first encountered on the Nautiloid during the prologue, where she serves as a temporary companion, and can be properly recruited on the Roadside Cliffs in Act One.
A ferocious warrior zealously devoted to the Lich Queen  Vlaakith, Lae'zel will do whatever is necessary to end the terror of the Illithid and prove herself to her queen.

entries.name: Laila
entries.description: Laila is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Lakrissa
entries.description: Lakrissa is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Lamona
entries.description: Lamona is a Sharran Fidelian within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace at X: -421 Y: -1651.

entries.name: Lann Tarv
entries.description: Lann Tarv is a merchant on the ground floor of Moonrise Towers in Act Two. His special inventory is not available unless a party member passes certain checks with  Z'rell after the introduction scene further within Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Lanni
entries.description: Harper Lanni is a lightfoot halfling ranger and Harper. Depending on if one of the original Harper allies are dead, she can take their place and help the party during the Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

entries.name: Lanpos Biggs
entries.description: Gondian Lanpos Biggs is a dead member of the Church of Gond in Act Three.

entries.name: Larche
entries.description: Fist Larche is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Laridda
entries.description: Apprentice Laridda is an enslaved deep gnome who is forced to dig out  Nere from the collapsed rubble in the Grymforge.

entries.name: Larys
entries.description: Fist Larys is a tiefling fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Lassandra
entries.description: Harper Lassandra leads a small group of Harpers on patrol to the hill east of Last Light Inn during Act Two.

entries.name: Leafsong
entries.description: Captain Leafsong is a high elven druid and a high-ranking member of the Harpers in Act Three. He joins  Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge, should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage.

entries.name: Leary Dowse
entries.description: Leary Dowse is a human civilian listening to  Umbrenne, a prophet of  Talona in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Legarioll
entries.description: Legarioll is one of the customers waiting in line at the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Leistine
entries.description:
Zoll, disguised as Harper Leistine,
 is a Doppelganger posing as a lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Leistine was killed and impersonated some time ago.

entries.name: Lens
entries.description: Lens is a journalist working for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette during Act Three.

entries.name: Leon
entries.description: Leon Onufrio is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador Szarr. He may appear at Camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Lester Farrower
entries.description: Lester Farrower is a dwarven customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Leucis Kallista
entries.description: Leucis Kallista is a tiefling refugee. He is begging for food with his family outside the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Lewis Morell
entries.description: Lewis Morell, named in-game as Dead Cultist, is an Absolutist cultist and paladin who can be found slain on the steps leading into High Hall.

entries.name: Leysin
entries.description: Leysin was a wood elven member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the  Mad Rashemaar, she was killed and impersonated by a Doppelganger named Lunn.

entries.name: Leythim
entries.description: Manip Leythim is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Lia
entries.description: Lia is a tiefling in Act One, who can be encountered in the Emerald Grove arguing with her siblings  Cal and  Rolan.

entries.name: Liadan
entries.description: Feloguard Liadan is a Human who can be encountered in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Liam
entries.description: Liam is a human trapped in the torture rack of the Shattered Sanctum in Act One.

entries.name: Liara Portyr
entries.description: Liara Portyr is a high-ranking Blaze of the Flaming Fist - often answering directly to Duke  Ulder Ravengard himself - and the niece of Duke  Dillard Portyr.

entries.name: Librarian Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Librarian Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Ligus
entries.description: Ligus is a ghoul in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Lilineth
entries.description: Harper Lilineth is a gold dwarven ranger and Harper. If one or more of the original Harper allies are dead, she takes their place and helps the party during the Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Lilly Beanbottom
entries.description: Lilly Beanbottom is a human child who sells newspapers in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Limeburn Sphagwood
entries.description: Limeburn Sphagwood is a human in Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game. He can be encounterd while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Limeleech
entries.description: Professor Limeleech is a Lolth-sworn drow druid and member of the Society of Brilliance.

entries.name: Limmy
entries.description: Limmy is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Lin'a'an
entries.description: Ardent Lin'a'an is a githyanki ardent and member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue in Act One.

entries.name: Linsella
entries.description: Linsella is a True Soul who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: Lionel (Graveyard)
entries.description: Lionel Brenton is a deceased human commoner in the Graveyard of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lionel (Rivington)
entries.description: Fist Lionel is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Lir'i'c
entries.description: Prelate Lir'i'c is a githyanki character encountered on the Astral Prism at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: Liron Dustclotter
entries.description: Liron Dustclotter is a dead human whose corpse is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: List of Bosses
entries.description: Bosses are a special type of character in Baldur's Gate 3. The informal term Boss is used by the community to describe those NPCs, but is not mentioned in Quests or in the Journal.

entries.name: List of characters
entries.description: This is a table of all characters in Baldur's Gate 3.  You can collapse the section for each chapter with the link/button on the right side.

entries.name: Listelia Dryselis
entries.description: Listelia Dryselis is a Dragonborn who, like her sister  Droralias Dryselis, was a smuggler for the Knights of the Shield before perishing to the Absolute.

entries.name: Liya
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Liya is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Lizabett
entries.description: Devastator Lizabett is a hobgoblin member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins, underneath Baldur's Gate. He attacks the party if they attempt to cross the Manslaughter Chasm.

entries.name: Lo
entries.description: Iron Consul Lo is a cultist of  Bane and one of  Gortash's bodyguards.

entries.name: Lobo Denysse
entries.description: Lobo Denysse is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Lochan
entries.description: Fist Lochan is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Locke
entries.description: Locke is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Loic
entries.description: Loic is one of the druids in the Emerald Grove during Act One. He is civil to visitors, but wary of guests who overstay their welcome.

entries.name: Lolo Fuzzletoes
entries.description: Lolo Fuzzletoes is discussing the possibility of being in the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Lora (goblin)
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Lora is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two.

entries.name: Lora Bergauz
entries.description: Lora, also known as Lora Bergauz, is a human in Baldur's Gate, initially found inside the Basilisk Gate Barracks during Act Three. She is the mother of  Vanra. Speaking to her can initiate the quest ⁠Save Vanra.

entries.name: Lord Amber's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lord Amber's Bodyguard is a half-elven monk who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Jannath's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lord Jannath's Bodyguard is a human barbarian who accompanies her master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Portyr's Attendant
entries.description: Lord Portyr's Attendant is a human wizard who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Portyr's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lord Portyr's Bodyguard is a half-elven ranger who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Shattershield's Attendant
entries.description: Lord Shattershield's Attendant is a rock gnome ranger who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard
entries.description: Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard is a halfling wizard who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lord Whitburn
entries.description: Lord Whitburn is an unnamed member of the  Whitburn patriar family chatting with  Lady Whitburn outside The Glitter Gala in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Loretta
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Loretta is a human member of the Cashguard in the high security vaults area, on the lowest floor of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Lorgan
entries.description: Father Lorgan was a cleric of Ilmater and a priest of the Open Hand Temple. His corpse is in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Lorin
entries.description: Lorin is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims. He is in the Entrance Gallery of the Overgrown Tunnel shouting at the party to stay back, and not to look. Lorin came to Auntie Ethel to look into his future and see what life path to pick.

entries.name: Lorlarrio
entries.description: Lorlarrio is a duergar bard and member of the Society of Brilliance.

entries.name: Lorna Esthelian
entries.description: Lorna Esthelian is a character in the Lower City Sewers that can be found in Act Three.

entries.name: Lorroakan
entries.description:
Lorroakan is the human proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries, in Act 3 of Baldur's Gate 3. He is in Ramazith's Tower, after traveling there from Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
He is searching for something called the Nightsong, and offers a large reward for finding it.

entries.name: Lorroakan's Projection
entries.description: Lorroakan's Projection is a programmed facsimile of  Lorroakan that manages the front desk at the Sorcerous Sundries.

entries.name: Loryss
entries.description: Geezer Loryss is a cabbage vendor in Act Three.

entries.name: Losiir
entries.description: Losiir is a githyanki fighter who replaces  Lae'zel's role in the Prologue while playing as her origin. Losiir has almost identical statistics and features to Lae'zel, but instead wields a scimitar and a longbow, and starts with the Defence fighting style.

entries.name: Loudstone
entries.description: Fist Loudstone is a dwarven ranger and a mamber of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Lowa
entries.description: Lowa is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, found enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.

entries.name: Loyal Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Loyal Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to Raphael.

entries.name: Lu La Forza
entries.description: Lu La Forza, or Chief Artificer Forza, is a human member of the Church of Gond.

entries.name: Luan
entries.description: News Hawker Luan is a child who sells newspapers in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Lucille
entries.description: Lucille is a named Skeleton employed in the Circus of the Last Days during Act Three.

entries.name: Lucretious
entries.description: Madam Lucretious, also known as Bringer of the Night or Mama Lucretious, is a high elven necromancer and the ringmaster of the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Lug
entries.description: Lug is a high elf civilian on the bridge leading to the House of Grief in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Lugarrio
entries.description: Lugarrio is a lightfoot halfling member of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three.

entries.name: Luke
entries.description: Strangler Luke is a member of the Cult of Bhaal. He joins the ambush on the party during the battle with Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev.

entries.name: Lumbar
entries.description: Strange Beggar Lumbar is a Zombie in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Lump
entries.description: Lump the Enlightened lurks in the ruined remains of Blighted Village with two ogre companions during Act One. Despite being an ogre, Lump has unusually high intelligence.

entries.name: Lunkbug
entries.description: Lunkbug is an Ironhand deep gnome in the Grymforge where the rubble collapsed in Act One.

entries.name: Lupir Neswaen
entries.description: Lupir Neswaen is a dead half-elf whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Lupus
entries.description: Lupus is a wolf summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Lupus "upgrades" to  Lupus Major once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Lupus Optumus once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Lupus Major
entries.description: Lupus Major is a wolf summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Lupus Major is upgraded from  Lupus once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Lupus Optumus once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Lupus Optumus
entries.description: Lupus Optumus is a wolf summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Lupus Optumus is the fully upgraded form of  Lupus and  Lupus Major once the Beast Master has reached level 11.

entries.name: Lur Fu
entries.description: Lur Fu is a spider in Grymforge during Act One. It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and  Murmath.

entries.name: Lur Jox
entries.description: Lur Jox is a spider in Grymforge during Act One. It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and  Murmath.

entries.name: Lur Otan
entries.description: Lur Otan is a spider in Grymforge during Act One. It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and  Murmath.

entries.name: Lur Xanta
entries.description: Lur Xanta is a spider in Grymforge during Act One. It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and  Murmath.

entries.name: Lurgan
entries.description: Lurgan is one of the duergars stationed in the Decrepit Village in Act One.

entries.name: Lurianna Sauvage
entries.description: Lurianna Sauvage is a deceased werewolf in Szarr's Palace in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Ly'iss
entries.description: Veteran Raider Ly'iss is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Lymn
entries.description: Harper Lymn is a Harper who patrols Last Light Inn during Act Two. She can help the party during ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

entries.name: Lyrthindor
entries.description: Lyrthindor is a secret Dark Justiciar in the Gauntlet of Shar.

entries.name: Lyrux Goldthroat
entries.description: Lyrux Goldthroat is a Bard who performs in the Guildhall within the Lower City Sewers.

entries.name: M'alice
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal M'alice is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: M'i'hayk
entries.description: Ember Gish'ra M'i'hayk is a githyanki character encountered in the Astral Plane at the end of Act Two. He is part of  Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him.

entries.name: Ma Festina
entries.description: Ma Festina attends the magic show at the square in front of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Ma'aryk
entries.description: Warrior Ma'aryk is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Ma'athal
entries.description: Veteran Warrior Ma'athal is a githyanki Veteran Warrior who attempts to ambush the party near the Road to Baldur's Gate in Reithwin Town within the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

entries.name: Madalitso
entries.description: Madalitso is a human patron of the Blushing Mermaid in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Maddala Deadeye
entries.description: Maddala Deadeye is a Human Rogue. As a hireling, she can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Madeline
entries.description: Madeline is a deceased dwarf whose corpse is on the Ruined Battlefield in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 125 Y: 106.

entries.name: Madeline Whitburn
entries.description: Lady Madeline Whitburn is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Madigan

entries.name: Maeve

entries.name: Maggie Ni Chuirc
entries.description: Maggie Ni Chuirc is a member of the Dead Eyes, a bandit group in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Maggran
entries.description: Maggran is a high half-elf in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Maghtew Budj

entries.name: Magmar
entries.description: Ward Magmar is a Flameshade duergar in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Magpie Davys
entries.description: Magpie Davys is a guest of The Guild who can be found near the bar in the Guildhall within the Undercity.

entries.name: Magron
entries.description: Magron is one of  Auntie Ethel's victims in the Overgrown Tunnel in Act One.

entries.name: Mahrin

entries.name: Majjo
entries.description: Night Blade Majjo is a human Night Blade in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Malayah

entries.name: Malus Thorm

entries.name: Malvo Rockfellow

entries.name: Mandii Harvestmoon

entries.name: Mango
entries.description: Mango is an elven member of The Guild.

entries.name: Manser Biggs

entries.name: Manus

entries.name: Mar'hyah

entries.name: Marcoryl

entries.name: Marcus (dead fisher)

entries.name: Mari
entries.description: Mari is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Marilla

entries.description: Mask of Terror is a human member of  Auntie Ethel's flock. He is in the Blushing Mermaid alongside  Mask of Vengeance,  Mask of Servitude, and the real  Captain Grisly.

entries.name: Mask of Vengeance (Overgrown Tunnel)
entries.description: The Mask of Vengeance is a drow half-elf member of  Auntie Ethel's flock. She is in the Overgrown Tunnel inside the Riverside Teahouse/Gnarled Teahouse in Act One.

entries.name: Mask of Vengeance (The Blushing Mermaid)
entries.description: Mask of Vengeance is a Human member of  Auntie Ethel's flock. He is in the Blushing Mermaid alongside  Mask of Servitude,  Mask of Terror, and the real  Captain Grisly.

entries.name: Mercer

entries.description: Adept Merim is a True Soul adept of the Cult of the Absolute in Act Two. She is stationed at the stairs leading into Moonrise Towers, guarding the entrance from intruders and assisting True Soul  Malik in vetting new arrivals.

entries.name: Merug 'Curly' Dugald

entries.name: Mezzka

entries.name: Mian

entries.name: Mibbs

entries.name: Mig

entries.name: Mikki Kori

entries.name: Miklaur

entries.name: Miller

entries.name: Milon Tillerturn

entries.name: Mind Flayer (nautiloid wreck)
entries.description: The Mind Flayer is in a weakened, dying state on the Ravaged Beach during Act One.

entries.name: Mind Flayer (prologue)
entries.description: The prologue Mind Flayer battles  Commander Zhalk on the Nautiloid.

entries.name: Minsc
entries.description:
Minsc of Rashemen is a recruitable Companion. He and  Jaheira return from both Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn and are the only two recruitable companions who cannot be romanced. He is a Human and a Hunter Ranger with the Folk Hero background.
Minsc can first be found in The Counting House, where he has been tadpole-converted by the Absolute into a True Soul and criminal gang-leader known as the Stone Lord. He can be found again in the Abandoned Cistern; knocking him out in the ensuing fight allows him to be freed from his brainwashing. 
After spending nearly a century  Petrified together, Minsc and his beloved hamster sidekick  Boo have finally been revived, and they seek a life of "butt-kicking" evil-doers to serve as a force of goodness, justice, and glory. 
Minsc is also the only character with access to the spell  Find Familiar: Boo.
Though voiced by Matthew Mercer, Minsc was motion-captured by other actors, Neil Newbon amongst them.

entries.name: Minthara
entries.description:
Nightwarden Minthara Baenre is a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a Lolth-Sworn Drow and an Oath of Vengeance Paladin with the Noble background.
Ruthless in service of the Absolute, she commands a camp of goblins planning an attack on the Emerald Grove in the name of their god. Initially hostile, she can be re-encountered during Act Two and saved from execution.

entries.name: Minthara/Zombie
entries.description: Zombie Minthara is a Minthara who died during one of the events of the game and is now transformed into a Zombie.

entries.name: Mir'ic

entries.name: Mîran
entries.description: Fist Mîran is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Mirg
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Mirg is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Mirie

entries.name: Mirileth
entries.description: Mirileth's corpse is in Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Mirkon

entries.name: Mirthis

entries.name: Misha

entries.name: Mitchia
entries.description: Unholy Assassin Mitchia is a member of the Cult of Bhaal. She is found in the Temple of Bhaal, in the Lower City Sewers, during Act Three.

entries.name: Mizora
entries.description: Mizora is a cambion in service of the Archdevil  Zariel, as well as the infernal patron of  Wyll. She plays an important role in Wyll's backstory, as well as his character arc throughout the game. Manipulative, mischievous and always looking to get the best out of her deals, she may be an asset or an adversary for the party, but always looks out for her own and Zariel's best interests.

entries.description: Mocking Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to Raphael.

entries.name: Mofty

entries.name: Mohan

entries.name: Mohlen
entries.description: Mohlen is a Black Gauntlet of Bane in Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

entries.name: Moke
entries.description: Sapper Moke is a goblin sapper in Act One.

entries.name: Mol

entries.name: Monk's Manifestation

entries.name: Monteith
entries.description: Monteith is a Sharran Novice in Act Three.

entries.name: Montgomery
entries.description: Montgomery is a human civilian visiting the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Moorcombe
entries.description: Doctor Moorcombe is a deep gnome wizard and member of the Society of Brilliance.

entries.name: Moorino
entries.description: Moorino is a human civilian who can be found in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three. He is being detained and "evaluated" by a Steel Watcher.

entries.name: Morbus

entries.name: Morgya
entries.description: Morgya is a duergar barbarian at the Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Morrus Pinfeather

entries.name: Moy

entries.name: Mrak
entries.description: Devout Mrak is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Munish
entries.description: Zealot Munish guards the western side of the Moonrise Towers throne room during Act Two.

entries.name: Murmath

entries.name: Murphy
entries.description: Fist Murphy is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Muttonchops Dexon

entries.name: Muttonchops Oreelly

entries.name: Muzul
entries.description: Devout Muzul is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Muzz

entries.name: Myer Ravenshade
entries.description: Lord Myer Ravenshade is a patriar of Baldur's Gate, present at  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Myrnath

entries.name: Myshka

entries.name: Mystic Carrion

entries.name: Mystra

entries.name: Naaber
entries.description: Naaber is an overly talkative human who can be found in Carm's Garms at X: 23 Y: 131.

entries.name: Nadi
entries.description: Zealot Nadi is a half-orc Zealot of the Absolute. He is in Moonrise Towers in Act Two, stationed next to the cells in Moonrise Towers Prison.

entries.name: Nadira
entries.description: Nadira is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Naiske

entries.name: Nalira

entries.name: Nansi Gretta

entries.name: Naoise Nallinto
entries.description: Naoise Nallinto is a Wood Elf courtesan working at Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Narvass
entries.description: Narvass is in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nass
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Nass is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nateen

entries.description: Harper Naysa is a Harper who patrols Last Light Inn during Act Two. She can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

entries.name: Nayzeem
entries.description: Tinker Nayzeem is a Human businessman in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Nealos Bright
entries.description: Nealos Bright is a halfling in the Rivington refugee camp.

entries.name: Ned'Cirannis
entries.description: Ned'Cirannis, named in-game as Dissected Drow, was an Absolute cultist who died during a scouting mission in Act One. His corpse was brought to the Emerald Grove for dissection.

entries.name: Neddio
entries.description: Fast Neddio is watching the Flaming Fist patrols in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Neem
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Neem is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nelburn Frust
entries.description: Nelburn Frust is a Baldurian in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Neno Quilltop
entries.description: Neno Quilltop is shopping for supplies in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Nephel
entries.description: Fist Nephel is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Nere
entries.description: Nere, also known as True Soul Nere, is a True Soul of the Absolute, and potential boss in Baldur's Gate 3. He is a pivotal character for the quests ⁠Free True Soul Nere, ⁠Save the Grymforge Gnomes and ⁠Deliver Nere's Head.

entries.name: Nere/Zombie
entries.description: Nere (Zombie) is a version of Nere who is killed by  Balthazar and resurrected as zombie.

entries.name: Nerela
entries.description: Nerela was a Tiefling refugee in the Hollow. She was never finished, and was cut from the game before the release of the Early Access version, though her model, animations, dialogue and interactions still remain in the game files.

entries.name: Nesha Leesha
entries.description: Nesha Leesha is a Baldur's Gate citizen. She is waiting for a friend to join her at the Blushing Mermaid tavern.

entries.name: Nessa
entries.description: Nessa is a displacer beast who can be found in the Gauntlet of Shar.

entries.name: Nestor
entries.description: Manip Nestor is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Nets Blandorf
entries.description: Nets Blandorf is a sailor sorting a haul of fish in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Nettie
entries.description: Nettie is a dwarven druid in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One. Nettie is a student under  First Druid Halsin. In his absence, she is the primary healer in the Emerald Grove.

entries.name: Ni'ima
entries.description: Warrior Ni'ima is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Nickelow
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Nickelow is a human member of the Cashguard, in the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Nickels
entries.description: Nickels Zeltron is a deep gnome member of Clan Ironhand in Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two.

entries.name: Nightmist
entries.description: Justiciar Crusader Nightmist is a high elf character in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Nik-Nuk
entries.description: Tracker Nik-Nuk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nimba'as
entries.description: Veteran Raider Nimba'as is a githyanki Veteran Raider who attempts to ambush the party near the Road to Baldur's Gate in Reithwin Town within the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

entries.name: Nimble
entries.description: Nimble Paternon is a Deep Gnome member of Clan Ironhand.

entries.name: Nimbus
entries.description: Nimbus is a shadow mastiff summoned via the Shadow Magic sorcerer's  Hound of Ill Omen ability.

entries.name: Nina Dortmell
entries.description: Nina Dortmell is a human child in the Graveyard of the Lower City.

entries.name: Nine-Fingers Keene
entries.description: Nine-Fingers Keene is the human Guildmaster of the Guild in the city of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Nipawa
entries.description: Fist Nipawa is a human Flaming Fist in Act Two. She can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Niram
entries.description: Zealot Niram is stationed on the east side of the Moonrise Towers throne room during Act Two.

entries.name: Nisvan
