entries.description: Nisvan is a dwarven refugee who appears just after entering Rivington.

entries.name: Nocturne
entries.description: Nocturne, formerly known as Rennald, is a Tiefling follower of  Shar and childhood friend of  Shadowheart.

entries.name: Nola
entries.description: Adept Nola is stationed on the west side of the Moonrise Towers throne room in Act Two.

entries.name: Nonabune
entries.description: Nonabune is a strongheart halfling walking by the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City.

entries.name: Nonah Baragezian
entries.description: Nonah Baragezian is a human refugee who appears just after entering Rivington.

entries.name: Norffe
entries.description: Chymist Norffe is a human who can be encountered in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Norya Baker
entries.description: Norya Baker is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Norys
entries.description: Fist Norys is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Notar Esojac
entries.description: Invoker of Bhaal Notar Esojac is a human Invoker of Bhaal found in the Stone Lord's hideout in the Abandoned Cistern within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Nov Shmoz
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Nov Shmoz is a human Death's Head of Bhaal found in the Stone Lord's hideout in the Abandoned Cistern within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Nozk
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Nozk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nrog
entries.description: Warrior Nrog is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Nubaldin
entries.description: Nubaldin is a rock gnome under the employ of  Raphael as the keeper of the Chamber of Egress within the House of Hope. He is self-important and easily angered, wistful about the days he was in charge of the House's prison, before he made a mistake and was reassigned.

entries.name: Nuff
entries.description: Iron Consul Nuff is a cultist of Bane in the audience chamber of Wyrm's Rock Fortress at X: -10 Y: 212.

entries.name: Numia
entries.description: Black Gauntlet Numia is a cultist of  Bane.

entries.name: Nyk
entries.description: High Gish'ra Nyk is a githyanki character encountered at the Wyrm's Crossing campsite at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: Nym Orlith
entries.description: Nym Orlith is a Seldarine Drow sex worker employed at Sharess' Caress, where she works alongside her twin brother,  Sorn Orlith.

entries.name: Nymessa
entries.description: Nymessa and  Damays are discussing a captive's fate in the Wilderness during Act One.

entries.name: Oathbreaker Knight
entries.description: The Oathbreaker Knight is an Undead Oathbreaker in Baldur's Gate 3 who appears before Paladin party members who have broken their oaths, becoming a temporary Camp Follower.

entries.name: Obelia Toobin
entries.description: Obelia Toobin is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond and daughter of  Zanner Toobin. She is held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Ogga
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Ogga is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Ogre Brute
entries.description: Ogre Brute is a creature which only appears during the raid on the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Ogreboy Colum
entries.description: Ogreboy Colum is a character whose corpse is in the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

entries.name: Ogro Nettles
entries.description: Ogro Nettles is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Ohara Ohira
entries.description: Ohara Ohira is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Okralope
entries.description: Fist Okralope is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Okta
entries.description: Okta is an elder of the tiefling refugees sheltering in the Emerald Grove in Act One. She is  Ikaron's mother.

entries.name: Olak
entries.description:
Sentinel Olak is a goblin stationed at the checkpoint just before the entrance to the Goblin Camp during Act One. Olak and Warrior Puce constantly argue with each other.
Despite the title of sentinel, Olak shares the same stats as other goblin warriors, except for a higher AC granted from a  Scrapwood Shield.

entries.name: Olam
entries.description: Olam is a dead aasimar Harper whose corpse is in the House of Healing Morgue. He attempted to lift the Shadow Curse more than a hundred years before the events of Act Two, until he eventually succumbed to the darkness.

entries.name: Old Flake-Eyes
entries.description: Old Flake-Eyes is a dragonborn follower of the Stone Lord.

entries.name: Old Troutman
entries.description: Old Troutman is a shield dwarven trader at the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City.

entries.name: Olfaith Olumssdottir
entries.description: Olfaith Olumssdottir is a doppelganger serving the cult of Bhaal.

entries.name: Oliver
entries.description: Oliver is in the House in Deep Shadows, within the Shadow-Cursed Lands region in Act Two.

entries.name: Oliver Quarlic
entries.description: Oliver Quarlic is one of the Gur, a human nomadic tribe. He is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3.

entries.name: Oliver Tefoco
entries.description: Oliver Tefoco is a merchant who works at the Beehive General Goods. He sells an assortment of potions and camp supplies.

entries.name: Olloa
entries.description: Fist Olloa is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Olly
entries.description: Olly is a human Zhentarim agent accompanying  Rugan during Act One.

entries.name: Olodan
entries.description: Olodan is a halfling druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Oloric Witmirth
entries.description: Oloric Witmirth is a human playwright suffering from writer's block. He is in the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Olys
entries.description: Harper Olys is an Asmodeus tiefling ranger and Harper. If one of the original Harper allies is dead, he can take their place and help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

entries.name: Omeluum
entries.description: Omeluum is a friendly Mind Flayer and trader in Baldur's Gate 3 who comes to the Ebonlake Grotto in the Underdark after being contacted by  Blurg. It is a member of the Society of Brilliance and can be asked to help ⁠remove their tadpole.

entries.name: Omotola
entries.description: Omotola is a human trader who manages The Glitter Gala in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: One
entries.description: One is a goblin child in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Onilla
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Onilla is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Ooltheg
entries.description: Ooltheg is one of the audience members at the show in front of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Orgarth
entries.description: Stone Guard Orgarth and  Morghal guard the entrance to Grymforge in Act One.

entries.name: Orik
entries.description: Brawler Orik is a goblin brawler in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Orin
entries.description: Orin the Red is the Chosen of  Bhaal and one of the leaders of the enigmatic Cult of the Absolute and serves as one of the main antagonists in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Oriona
entries.description: Fist Oriona is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Ormn
entries.description: Ormn is a Bear in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Ormont
entries.description: Ormont is intent on forming an employee strike in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Orpheus
entries.description: Orpheus is a Githyanki who appears in Baldur's Gate 3, playing a central role in Act Three and  Lae'zel's personal quest, ⁠The Githyanki Warrior. As the son of Gith herself, he acts as the supposed true ruler of the Gith Empire. However, he has been captured and imprisoned in the Astral Plane by  Vlaakith. Being a githyanki, he seeks to destroy the mind flayers, and as the true githyanki prince, he strives to remove Vlaakith from power.

entries.name: Orvil
entries.description: Fist Orvil is a deceased human member of the Flaming Fist. His corpse is in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Oskar Fevras
entries.description: Oskar Fevras is a human and well known painter in the city of Baldur's Gate, who is being trafficked by the Zhentarim.

entries.name: Osmund
entries.description: Fist Osmund is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Otto Ott
entries.description: Otto Ott is a human found inside a cell in Wyrm's Rock Prison during Act Three.

entries.name: Owlbear Cub
entries.description: Owlbear Cub is a Beast and a potential Camp Follower in the Owlbear Nest with his mother in Act One.

entries.name: Owltalon
entries.description: Justiciar Crusader Owltalon is a high elven character in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Padulla
entries.description: Padulla is an Untaken of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Pagnola
entries.description: Fist Healer Pagnola is a dwarven healer and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Pammella Nortale
entries.description: Pammella Nortale is a halfling in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Pandirna
entries.description: Pandirna is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. With her legs paralysed from a dodgy brew, she is given the duty of guarding the refugees' storage hut.

entries.name: Pantella
entries.description: Fist Pantella is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Panther
entries.description: Panther is a wild shape available to druids via  Wild Shape: Panther.

entries.name: Paramidious
entries.description: Paramidious is a redcap at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three.

entries.name: Patricia
entries.description: Sister Patricia is an Undead Nurse in Reithwin during Act Two.

entries.name: Patrick
entries.description: Fist Patrick is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Patty
entries.description: Patty is a wood elven commoner. She is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Pavel
entries.description: Fist Recruit Pavel is a human ranger and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. He is on the Risen Road in Act One.

entries.name: Peetri Sname
entries.description: Peetri Sname is a human civilian. She may appear near Bonecloak's Apothecary in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Peil Hullhollyn
entries.description: Admiral Peil Hullhollyn is a patriar of Baldur's Gate, present at the ceremony of  Gortash's ordaining as an Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Penela Lumpensicks
entries.description: Penela Lumpensicks is a dead Half-Elf whose corpse is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Penita
entries.description: Penita is a dead Sister of the Open Hand Assuagia on a ship in Act Three.

entries.name: Perfect Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Perfect Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Petras
entries.description: Pale Petras is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador Szarr, and one of  Astarion's siblings. He may appear at Fraygo's Flophouse or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Petric Amber
entries.description: Lord Petric Amber is a patriar of Baldur's Gate, present at the ceremony of  Enver Gortash's ordaining as an Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Phanellis
entries.description: Fist Healer Phanellis is a dwarven healer and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Pharbz
entries.description: Refugee Pharbz is a halfling civilian in the Undercity of Baldur's Gated during in Act Three.

entries.name: Pharnilla
entries.description: Pharnilla is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Phase
entries.description: Phase is a rock gnome monk and Zhent working as a mercenary for the Guild and  Nine-Fingers Keene. He is at the southwestern corner of the Guildhall, standing guard in the event of an attack by the  Stone Lord.

entries.name: Phelgro Dorph
entries.description: Phelgro Dorph is a halfling civilian. He is attempting to comfort  Fevrokis after he found the bodies of his dead parents in the Brampton district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Phibs Brogan
entries.description: Phibs Brogan is a dwarven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Philomeen
entries.description: Philomeen is a Deep Gnome in Baldur's Gate 3. She can give the party a  Runepowder Vial.

entries.name: Phinn Truscott
entries.description: Phinn Truscott is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Phlanders Hort
entries.description: Phlanders Hort is an assistant employee in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Phoebelia
entries.description: Phoebelia is a patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Phoenix Lubbins
entries.description: Phoenix Lubbins is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Phoskyx
entries.description: Phoskyx appears just north of the  Baldur's Gate waypoint in the Lower City.

entries.name: Phostlethwaite
entries.description: Phostlethwaite is a guest of The Guild, drinking with Tut Thistlebog in the Guildhall at X: -16 Y: 739.

entries.name: Phrennog
entries.description: Phrennog is in the Lower City waiting to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Phubbs
entries.description: Doorman Phubbs is an elven greeter to  Lady Jannath who can be encountered in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City.

entries.name: Phylle
entries.description: Night Blade Phylle is a human Night Blade found in the Undercity outside the Guildhall in Act Three.

entries.name: Pickles
entries.description: Pickles is a human child who is behind the Elfsong Tavern during Act Three.

entries.name: Piddle
entries.description: Booyahg Piddle is a Goblin Booyahg reading a book in one of the ruined towers of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Pig
entries.description: Pig is a beast in Act Three and non-playable race. He resides in the Requisitioned Barn in Rivington. He can be spoken to using Speak with Animals.

entries.name: Pinta
entries.description: Pinta is a halfling druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Pippin Bow
entries.description: Gondian Pippin Bow is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond who can be found in the Steel Watch Foundry during Act Three.

entries.name: Pippindoch
entries.description: Pippindoch is a dead halfling whose corpse is near the High Hall during Act Three.

entries.name: Pistle
entries.description: Ward Pistle is a Flameshade duergar in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Plig
entries.description: Warrior Plig is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Pol
entries.description: Houndmaster Pol is a ghost who may appear in the Durinbold Mausoleum in Baldur's Gate's Lower City.

entries.name: Pollo the Muscle
entries.description: Pollo the Muscle is a high half-elf fighter and ally of  Counsellor Florrick. He is part of the retinue that confronts the party after  Wyll breaks his pact with  Mizora.

entries.name: Polma
entries.description: Polma guards the Priestess' chambers in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Pompton Norvath
entries.description: Pompton Norvath is disgruntled about the crime in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Pookums
entries.description: Pookums is a human child in the Graveyard of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Pooldripp
entries.description: Pooldripp the Zealous is a Kuo-toa in the Underdark during Act One, leading the worship of  BOOOAL.

entries.name: Poole
entries.description: Fist Poole is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Popper
entries.description: Popper is a kobold at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington. He sells items he has looted from corpses.

entries.name: Postmaster Badger
entries.description: Postmaster Badger is a badger who coordinates information deliveries for the Harpers.

entries.name: Preciosa
entries.description: Saer Preciosa is a half-elven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Preyn
entries.description: Watchman Preyn is a member of the City Watch in the Upper City in Act Three. She attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute.

entries.name: Pritt Yellowbreath
entries.description: Pritt Yellowbreath is a brass dragonborn civilian near Bonecloak's Apothecary in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Ptaris
entries.description: Ptaris is a Githyanki located in the Society of Brilliance Lodge in the Lower City during Act Three. He will only be there if the stolen githyanki egg was given to  Lady Esther as part of the quest ⁠Steal a Githyanki Egg.

entries.name: Ptaris' Mental Image
entries.description: Ptaris' Mental Images are Constructs created by  Ptaris in the Society of Brilliance Lodge in the Lower City during Act Three. If you enter combat with him, he starts with 2 mental images.

entries.name: Puce
entries.description: Warrior Puce is a goblin stationed at the checkpoint just before the entrance to the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Puli
entries.description: Tracker Puli is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Pumler Grejit
entries.description: Pumler Grejit is one of the Gur, the human nomadic tribe. He is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3.

entries.name: Punkins
entries.description: Punkins is a human child in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Pyrindath
entries.description: Youth Pyrindath is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Pythonicus
entries.description: Pythonicus is a dragonborn who can be found in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Qen
entries.description: Warrior Qen is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Qora
entries.description: Devilish Qora is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Qu'th
entries.description: Ardent Qu'th is a member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue during Act One.

entries.name: Qudenos
entries.description: Qudenos is a red dragon who can be first encountered at the Mountain Pass. He serves  Kith'rak Voss, a legendary Githyanki knight in search of the  Mysterious Artefact.

entries.name: Queelia Arvis
entries.description: Queelia Arvis is the cook at Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Quelat Quimms
entries.description: Quelat Quimms is a dead human whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Quelenna
entries.description: Quelenna is a high-elven bandit looting the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Quenora Grisly
entries.description: Captain Grisly, also known as Quenora Grisly, is the owner of the Blushing Mermaid. She can be found in the Lower City during Act Three and is too hungover to speak to the party, unless they discuss  Vanra.

entries.name: Quickstitch
entries.description: Fist Quickstitch is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Quil Grootslang
entries.description: Quil Grootslang is a silver dragonborn singer and composer in Baldur's Gate 3. She is a temporary Camp Follower, who appears at the party's campsite if the  The Dark Urge is played as Origin.

entries.name: Quinton
entries.description: Quinton is a human commoner in the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington.

entries.name: Qun'irel
entries.description: Youth Qun’irel is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Ra'gur
entries.description: Raider Ra'gur is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Ra'jak
entries.description: Ra'jak is a githyanki child who can be found in Act One. He is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y'llek.

entries.name: Raagg
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Raagg is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Rabbelle
entries.description: Rabbelle is one of the human onlookers witnessing Volo's execution scene at the Grey Harbour Docks in Act Three.

entries.name: Racha
entries.description: Racha is a goblin who can be met at Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Radija
entries.description: Radija is a necromancer of the Cult of Myrkul. She is on the first floor of Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Rags Deelarma
entries.description: Rags Deelarma is a human beggar just outside the entrance to the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Rahir
entries.description: Fist Rahir is a Flaming Fist under the command of  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.

entries.name: Rakath Glitterbeard
entries.description: Rakath Glitterbeard is the dwarven head banker of the Counting House, in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Raloric Windbane
entries.description: Raloric Windbane is a corpse in the crypt underneath the Open Hand Temple in Rivington. He is raised as a Greater Zombie if the party refuses to take the curse from the  Sentient Amulet (Rare).

entries.name: Ramona Flintsplitter
entries.description: Ramona Flintsplitter is a Dwarf in the Rivington refuge camp.

entries.name: Rancer
entries.description: Brawler Rancer is stationed on the eastern side of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Randolf Vammas
entries.description: Lord Randolf Vammas is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Raphael
entries.description:
“
     The mouse smiled brightly: it outfoxed the cat! Then down came the claw and that, love, was that.
     „

entries.name: Rascal Borys
entries.description: Rascal Borys is a tiefling child in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Rat (albino)
entries.description: Rat is an unnamed rat who steals scraps from the basement of Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing during Act 3.

entries.name: Rath
entries.description: Rath is a human druid in Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Raven (white)
entries.description: Raven is the albino companion of He Who Was.

entries.name: Raylen Jannath
entries.description: Lord Raylen Jannath is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present at  Enver Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Reagan Splint
entries.description: Reagan Splint is staying at a hostel in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Reanimated Corpse
entries.description: Reanimated Corpses are zombie dwarves, resurrected by  Gekh Coal in the Underdark to attack the party.

entries.name: Rechel
entries.description: Rechel is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Reconstituted Arcanist
entries.description: The Reconstituted Arcanist is a skeleton creature in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Rectus
entries.description: Rectus is a ghoul in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Redhammer
entries.description: Redhammer is a dwarven submarine driver in Flymm Cargo's Basement.

entries.name: Refugee (The Risen Road)
entries.description: Refugee is an unnamed corpse in the Risen Road Toll House during Act One.

entries.name: Reklan
entries.description: Reklan is a human guard.

entries.name: Remira
entries.description: Remira is a human adventurer travelling with  Aradin and  Barth in Act One.

entries.name: Renan
entries.description: Zealot Renan is located outside Moonrise Towers in Act Two. She patrols around the towers' docks.

entries.name: Reynash
entries.description: Fist Reynash is a gnome wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Rhaneld
entries.description: Rhaneld is a human child who played a prank on  Bastian d'Zinn outside of Elerrathin's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Rhed
entries.description: Fist Rhed is a gold dwarf Flaming Fist in Act Two. He can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Rheg'zel
entries.description: Youth Rheg'zel is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Rhett
entries.description: Rhett is a human child. She is part of a local militia in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Rhol
entries.description: Queen Rhol, the Despoiler is a tiefling dancer in Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Rhy
entries.description: Rhy is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Ri'zel
entries.description: Gate Master Ri'zel is a githyanki in the Knights of the Shield Hideout in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Rih'al
entries.description: M'lar Rih'al is a scout who discovered the Rosymorn Monastery is now a location for a githyanki Crèche.

entries.name: Rikka
entries.description: Rikka is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She is one of the guards on the gate's ramparts, and is Doni's guardian.

entries.name: Rilia
entries.description: Rilia is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Rindle
entries.description: Tracker Rindle is a goblin stationed at a checkpoint just before the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Rion
entries.description: Rion is a high half-elf druid in Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Ripper
entries.description: Ripper, named Goblin Brawler in-game, is a goblin who only can be encountered during the goblin camp celebration if the party betrayed the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Rizzle
entries.description: Rizzle, named in-game as Goblin Brawler, is a goblin brawler who greets the party if they enter the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Mountain Pass during Act Two.

entries.name: Roah Moonglow
entries.description: Roah Moonglow is a halfling Trader and member of the Zhentarim who first appears in the Shattered Sanctum within the Goblin Camp.

entries.name: Robbin Datherswick
entries.description: Robbin Datherswick is a strongheart halfling customer of Felogyr's Fireworks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Roberon Silt
entries.description: Roberon Silt is a trader in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Robyn
entries.description: Robyn is a civilian behind a locked door in the courtyard of High Hall during the final sequence of Act Three.

entries.name: Rockbothem
entries.description: Fist Rockbothem is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Rockbreed
entries.description: Fist Rockbreed is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Rocky
entries.description: Rocky is an undead ghost dog in the Durinbold Mausoleum in Baldur's Gate's Lower City.

entries.name: Rodondo Logg
entries.description: Rodondo Logg is in front of the Singing Lute in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Roger Gherkins
entries.description: Roger Gherkins is a halfling patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Roger Highberry
entries.description: Roger Highberry is a citizen hosting a wine festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Rolan
entries.description: Rolan is an aspiring wizard who is first located in the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is bound for Baldur's Gate with his two siblings, where a prestigious apprenticeship awaits.

entries.name: Rolan's Projection
entries.description: Rolan's Projection is a programmed facsimile of  Rolan, that greets and trades with guests in the Sorcerous Sundries. Since it is a projected image, it cannot be targeted or attacked.

entries.name: Roo
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Roo is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Rosanna
entries.description: Adventurer Rosanna is a guest of Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Rose
entries.description: Sister Rose the Penitent is a member of the Open Hand Temple in Act Three.

entries.name: Rossina
entries.description: Rossina is a forest gnome on a stroll on the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City.

entries.name: Rot
entries.description: Brawler Rot is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Roveer
entries.description: Chef Roveer is a dwarf working as a chef at the Elfsong Tavern in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Rowan (Mountain Pass)
entries.description: Flaming Fist Rowan is a Flaming Fist killed by a githyanki patrol on the Risen Road at X: -148 Y: 569.

entries.name: Rowan (Requisitioned Barn)
entries.description: Fist Rowan is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Rowan Elkfriend
entries.description: Rowan Elkfriend is a patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Rox Flunter
entries.description: Rox Flunter is a human civilian near the Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Rozes Kallista
entries.description: Rozes Kallista is a tiefling refugee. She is begging for food with her family outside the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Rozzak
entries.description: Rozzak is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Rrripper
entries.description: Rrripper is a named white Worg in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Rua
entries.description: Warrior Rua is a goblin raider in Act One.

entries.name: Rudd
entries.description: Rudd is a Doppelganger in the Under Temple Cave Area under the Open Hand Temple in Act Three.

entries.name: Rugan
entries.description: Rugan is a human agent of the Zhentarim trapped in a cave on the Risen Road, desperately trying to fend off  Flind's gnoll pack.

entries.name: Rugger Shattershield
entries.description: Lord Rugger Shattershield is a patriar of Baldur's Gate, present at the ordination of  Gortash's as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Rull
entries.description: Rull is a Doppelganger. It can be found in the Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate if  Dolor is attempting to kill  Figaro Pennygood as part of Investigate the Murders.

entries.name: Runt
entries.description: Runt is a Human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Rurik
entries.description: Rurik was a Dwarf Rogue located outside the Risen Road Toll House, in Early Access.

entries.name: Ruth Linnacker
entries.description: Lady Ruth Linnacker is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present at  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Rycke
entries.description: Unholy Assassin Rycke is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in Temple of Bhaal in the Lower City Sewers during Act Three.

entries.name: Ryland
entries.description: Ryland is a doppelganger assuming a human appearance found in Act Three. Ryland and  Keren are ostensibly animal tamers for the Circus of the Last Days, but secretly serve  Orin and the Cult of the Absolute.

entries.name: Rylveth
entries.description: Zealot Rylveth is stationed in the study behind the Moonrise Towers throne room in Act Two.

entries.name: Sabre-Tooth Tiger
entries.description: Sabre-Toothed Tiger is a wild shape available to druids via  Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger.

entries.name: Sacrificed Cultist (high elf)
entries.description: Sacrificed Cultist (high elf) is an unconscious high elf aboard the Nautiloid in the Prologue. He is psionically drained by a red glowing contraption.

entries.name: Sacrificed Cultist (human)
entries.description: Sacrificed Cultist is an unconscious human aboard the Nautiloid in the Prologue. He is psionically drained by a red glowing contraption.

entries.name: Sacrum
entries.description: Strange Beggar Sacrum wanders the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Safyre
entries.description: Safyre is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Salamander
entries.description: Salamander is performing a show with two wizards in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Salazon
entries.description: Salazon is a human who guards a Zhentarim hideout in Act One.

entries.name: Sally Flymm
entries.description: Sally Flymm is a human who runs Flymm's Cobblers along with her husband,  Dravo Flymm. She is also the mother of  Enver Gortash. Sally and Dravo are available to trade with, selling a small selection of camp shoes.

entries.name: Sallyanne Corks
entries.description: Sallyanne Corks is a dead Drow whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Samwell Staxford
entries.description: Samwell Staxford, named in-game as Dead Zealot of the Absolute, was an  Absolutist zealot on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail during Act One. After he accidentally stumbled upon hostile githyanki youth, he raised a group of undead  Death Shepherds and  Ghouls to assist him but ultimately perished in the ensuing fight.

entries.name: Sanseverina
entries.description: Sanseverina is a deceased half-elven character, who was enticed to attend a ball at the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Santoria
entries.description: Santoria is a human member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Sarabayle
entries.description: Sarabayle is a necromancer of the Cult of Myrkul found in Act Two. She appears in the Moonrise Towers Prison after the party launch ⁠the assault on the cult.

entries.name: Sarafin
entries.description: Sarafin is an elven adventurer. She is meeting up with her group in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Sarevok Anchev
entries.description: Sarevok Anchev is a legendary Bhaalspawn. He was the main antagonist of Baldur's Gate and a possible companion in Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal. He can be found in the Murder Tribunal under Candulhallow's Tombstones during Act Three.

entries.name: Sarin
entries.description: Sarin is a dead, ghostly character located in the Lower City Sewers.

entries.name: Sarken Eomane
entries.description: Lord Sarken Eomane is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present at  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Saunder
entries.description: Fist Saunder is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Savora
entries.description: Blaze Savora  is human wizard and the member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Sazza
entries.description: Sazza is a goblin follower of the Absolute. She is in the Makeshift Prison in Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Scared Boar
entries.description: Scared Boar is on the Ravaged Beach during Act One.

entries.name: Scarpers
entries.description: Scarpers is a member of  Zenovia's gang and member of The Guild. He is outside  Arfur Gregorio's mansion in Rivington.

entries.name: Sceleritas Fel
entries.description: Sceleritas Fel is a Fiend in Baldur's Gate 3 integral to  The Dark Urge's past. While he himself encourages his master towards evil, the Dark Urge can be resisted. He only appears within a Dark Urge playthrough, or if The Dark Urge is within a Multiplayer party.

entries.name: Sconnor
entries.description: Refugee Sconnor is a half-elf civilian in the Undercity of Baldur's Gated during in Act Three.

entries.name: Scratch
entries.description: Scratch is a dog and a potential Camp Follower and Attached Follower encountered in the Forest during Act One.

entries.name: Scratchy
entries.description: Scratchy is a named Crawling Claw in the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Scrawny Bugbear
entries.description: Scrawny Bugbear is sleeping in the Blighted Village during Act One.

entries.name: Sebastian
entries.description: Sebastian is an Undead Vampire Spawn who is imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: Seralia Devers
entries.description: Seralia Devers is a human commoner. She is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Serrik
entries.description: Fist Serrik is an elven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.

entries.name: Severn
entries.description: Severn is the Guildhall bartender in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Seyama
entries.description: Manip Seyama is a human ranger and a sergeant of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Sh'ari
entries.description: High Gish'ra Sh'ari is a githyanki character encountered in the Astral Plane at the end of Act Two. She is part of  Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Flaming Fist
entries.description: Shadow-Cursed Flaming Fist are a type of undead creature which may appear in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are Flaming Fist who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless zombies.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Githyanki Warrior
entries.description: Shadow-Cursed Githyanki Warriors are a type of creature which may appear in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are Githyanki who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Harper
entries.description: Shadow-Cursed Harpers are Harpers who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures. They can be found in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Pilgrim
entries.description: Shadow-Cursed Pilgrims are a type of undead creature which may appear in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are pilgrims who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound
entries.description: A Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound is a type of Shambling Mound and a boss enemy in the Shadow-Cursed Lands of Act Two.

entries.name: Shadow-Cursed Zealot
entries.description: Shadow-Cursed Zealots are a type of undead creature which may appear in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are zealots who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures.

entries.name: Shadow-Whiskers
entries.description: Shadow-Whiskers is a displacer beast at the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Shadowheart
entries.description:
Shadowheart (born Jenevelle Hallowleaf) is an Origin character and a recruitable companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a high half-elf and a Trickery Domain Cleric with the Acolyte background. Shadowheart can be first found on the Nautiloid during the prologue where she serves as a temporary companion, and can be properly recruited at various points in Act One.
As a loyal servant of the goddess  Shar, Shadowheart can be cold and calculating, willing to do whatever is necessary to serve the Dark Lady with utter devotion.

entries.name: Shah
entries.description: Fist Shah is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Shameful Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Shameful Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Shargil
entries.description: Fist Shargil is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Sharran Fidelian
entries.description: Sharran Fidelian is the generic title given to arcane spellcasters who worship  Shar.

entries.name: Sharran Novice
entries.description: Sharran Novice is the title given to initiate followers of  Shar.

entries.name: Sharran Spider
entries.description: Sharran Spider is a spider form that  Viconia DeVir may transform herself and her allies into using  Mapped Terror: Spiders, in order to terrify the player party.

entries.name: Sharran Wolf (Viconia)
entries.description: Sharran Wolf is a wolf form that Viconia DeVir may transform herself into using  Mapped Terror: Wolves. She also transforms nearby Sharran Novices into a weaker version of this form.

entries.name: Shattered Duergar
entries.description: Shattered Duergar is a dead character whose corpse is on the beach area of the Underdark during Act One.

entries.name: Shekt
entries.description: Booyahg Shekt is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Sherrill
entries.description: Sherrill is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Shirra Clarwen
entries.description: Sister Shirra Clarwen is the dead granddaughter of the Monk's Manifestation and follower of Ilmater, who lived in the Open Hand Temple in Rivington.

entries.name: Shiv Dahlia
entries.description: Shiv Dahlia is a human follower of the Stone Lord.

entries.name: Shrev
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Shrev is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Shuna Huanje
entries.description: Shuna Huanje is a dwarven customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Shuurga
entries.description: Manip Shuurga is a half-orc wizard and an officer of the Flaming Fist. She can be encountered in the Mind Flayer Colony in Act Two.

entries.name: Siggy
entries.description: Siggy is a gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Sigurd
entries.description: Feloguard Sigurd is a human in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game. He is seen while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Silas Silvertongue
entries.description: Silas Silvertongue, disguised as a Tipplesome Patron, is a Redcap Boatswain in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Silfy
entries.description: Silfy is a tiefling child in Act One. She assists her brother  Mattis in his scams for  Mol's gang of tiefling refugee children through pickpocketing passersby.

entries.name: Silifrey Sashenstar
entries.description: Lady Silifrey Sashenstar is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present for the ordination of  Gortash's as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Silver
entries.description: Silver is a wolf in the Circle of the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Sina'zith
entries.description: Sina'zith is a Githyanki Monk. As a hireling, she can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Sinda
entries.description: Sister Sinda is an Undead Nurse who works at the House of Healing during Act Two.

entries.name: Sinister Hooded Man
entries.description: Sinister Hooded Man is a human Night Blade found in Bloomridge Park in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Sir Fuzzalump
entries.description: Sir Fuzzalump is a Rock Gnome Wizard. As a hireling, he can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Skarjall
entries.description: Herdmaster Skarjall is a duergar at Grymforge in Act One.

entries.name: Skeeve Stabwell
entries.description: Skeeve Stabwell is a human member of The Guild

entries.name: Skickpit
entries.description: Skickpit is an enslaved Ironhand deep gnome who was captured by duergar cultists. Skickpit toils in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Skittle
entries.description: Skittle is a rat merchant found inside a cell in Heapside Prison during Act Three.

entries.name: Skoan
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Skoan is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Skoona
entries.description: Enforcer Skoona is a half-orc employee of the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Skrut
entries.description: Skrut is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Slack-Skinned Head
entries.description: The Slack-Skinned Head and Mind-Archive Interface are side-by-side in the Mind Flayer Colony. They are accessible after defeating a Death Shepherd, some winged horrors and various Zombies.

entries.name: Slarmy
entries.description: Slarmy is a Lightfoot halfling. He is near the broken cart east of the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Slatey Marven
entries.description: Slatey Marven provides unsolicited art criticism in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Sleam
entries.description: Captain Sleam is a sailor at Grey Harbour Docks of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Sledge Pettifeet
entries.description: Sledge Pettifeet is a halfling member of The Guild.

entries.name: Slice
entries.description: Tracker Slice orders her subordinates to loot Blighted Village during Act One.

entries.name: Slick Inatra
entries.description: Slick Inatra is a high half elven ranger and sergeant of the Zhentarim in the Guildhall, during Act Three. She is the local leader of the Zhent mercenaries, protecting the Guildhall against Stone Lord intrusions.

entries.name: Slog
entries.description: Slog is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Sloncha Owena
entries.description: Sloncha Owena is a Wood Elf having a picnic with  Bogdan Vortleson outside of the Windmill in Rivington.

entries.name: Slorsha Grommer
entries.description: Slorsha Grommer is one of the onlookers witnessing Volo's execution scene at the Grey Harbour Docks in Act Three.

entries.name: Slow-Butt
entries.description: Slow-Butt is a human child in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Slozy Arminifer
entries.description: Slozy Arminifer is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Sluck
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Sluck is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Slumgullion
entries.description: Slumgullion is a halfling civilian who is behind the Elfsong Tavern.

entries.name: Small Klaw
entries.description: Small Klaw is a named worg and one of  Klaws's pups, at the checkpoint just before the entrance to the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Smathers
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Smathers is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Smiley Gheef
entries.description: Smiley Gheef is a human merchant who can be found negotiating with  Trader Djingo in the Grey Harbour Docks during Act Three.

entries.name: Smilin' Ginna
entries.description: Smilin' Ginna is a human member of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three.

entries.name: Smithwynn
entries.description: Fist Smithwynn is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Smouldering Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Smouldering Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Smythin
entries.description: Smythin is a human captive in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Snapbone
entries.description: Snapbone is a member of The Guild.

entries.name: Sneezer Phibbs
entries.description: Sneezer Phibbs is a human child. He is at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Snicker
entries.description: Snicker is a Hyena which can be found in the Abandoned Cistern hideout in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate. Snicker is part of the Stone Lord's crew.

entries.name: Snirr
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Snirr is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Snurd
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Snurd is a goblin stationed at the entrance of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Soapstone
entries.description: Gauntlet Soapstone is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist in the Lower City.

entries.name: Solras
entries.description: Solras is a dwarven refugee who appears just after entering Rivington.

entries.name: Somi
entries.description: Somi is a half-orc guard working for Entharl Danthelon in Danthelon's Dancing Axe in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Soreni
entries.description: Zealot Soreni is stationed in the Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two.

entries.name: Sorn Orlith
entries.description: Sorn Orlith is a Seldarine Drow sex worker employed at Sharess' Caress, where he works alongside his twin sister,  Nym Orlith.

entries.name: Soxx
entries.description: Soxx is a Doppelganger. It can be found in the Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate if  Dolor is attempting to kill  Figaro Pennygood as part of Investigate the Murders.

entries.name: Spar
entries.description: Spar is a Squirrel in the Emerald Grove in Act One. He can be found next to  Alfira, painfully listening to her sing alongside  Corinna.

entries.name: Spargo Ovilliers
entries.description: Spargo Ovilliers is a human. He is on the stairs towards the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Sparks Musgravel
entries.description: Sparks Musgravel is a human member of The Guild.

entries.name: Sparky
entries.description: Sparky is a dog who can be found at Bloomridge Park in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Spatula Farggo
entries.description: Spatula Farggo is a dwarven kitchen worker in the Elfsong Tavern distributing leftovers to hungry Baldur's Gate citizens during Act Three.

entries.name: Spaulder
entries.description: Death's Head of Bhaal Spaulder is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, found in Bloomridge Park in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Spaw
entries.description: Sovereign Spaw is a myconid in Baldur's Gate 3. It is the Sovereign of the Myconid colony in Ebonlake Grotto.

entries.name: Spike
entries.description: Torturer Spike is a goblin and follower of the Absolute. He and  Lookout Grush are torturing  Liam next to the Bloodied Shrine within the Shattered Sanctum of the Goblin Camp.

entries.name: Splatters Doolug
entries.description: Splatters Doolug created the murals on the wall east of Lora's House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Splintered Shadow Hound
entries.description: Splintered Shadow Hound is a shadow mastiff summoned via the reaction Splinter Shadow.

entries.name: Spool
entries.description: Spool is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Squire
entries.description: Squire is an undead dog in Ketheric Thorm's room on the first floor of Moonrise Towers during Act Two. Squire takes the form of a filigreed skeleton, as loyal in death as she was in life.

entries.name: Sszaryn
entries.description: Sszaryn, named Dead Drow Raider, can be found dead in front of Waukeen's Rest in Act One.

entries.name: Stalker Svignee
entries.description: Stalker Svignee is a Death Knight who appears in the Upper City Sewers.

entries.name: Stalwart
entries.description: Iron Consul Stalwart is a cultist of  Bane and one of  Enver Gortash's bodyguards during Act Three.

entries.name: Star Stolitti
entries.description: Seawind Star Stolitti is a Savage Seawind of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Starrlet
entries.description: Fist Starrlet is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Steelclaw
entries.description: Steelclaw is a cat in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Steffy
entries.description: Steffy is a Human child in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three.

entries.name: Sterlac
entries.description: Sterlac is a murdered party guest in the Szarr Palace in the Upper City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Sticky Dondo
entries.description: Sticky Dondo is a human child who runs the Fetcher's Brats shop out of the Guildhall.

entries.name: Stijin
entries.description: Stijin is a Black Gauntlet of Bane and one of  Lord Enver Gortash's bodyguards during Act Three.

entries.name: Stimk
entries.description: Stimk is a sleeping bugbear in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Stinker
entries.description: Stinker is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Stivvo
entries.description: Cashier Stivvo is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Stoney
entries.description: Stoney is a mud elemental at the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Stornugoss
entries.description: Ghustil Stornugoss is the principal healer of Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Strange Ox
entries.description: The Strange Ox is a mysterious ox first encountered in the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Stug Minedale
entries.description: Stug Minedale is a dwarven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Sue
entries.description: Thunderstorm Sue is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Sul (goblin)
entries.description: Warrior Sul is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Sul (pilgrim)
entries.description: Pilgrim Sul is a human in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Sula Ghevora
entries.description: Sula Ghevora is an elven civilian waiting in a queue with her partner  Tuloria in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Sulian
entries.description: Harper Sulian is a rock gnome druid and a member of the Harpers in Act Three. She joins  Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge, should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage.

entries.name: Sumera
entries.description: Questioner Sumera is charged with interrogating prisoners in Moonrise Towers Prison with  Jasin during Act Two.

entries.name: Surixana
entries.description: Surixana is a dragonborn in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Susdera
entries.description: Susdera is a necromancer of the Cult of Myrkul. She is atop Moonrise Towers, and assists  Ketheric Thorm in battle against the party.

entries.name: Suttida Attana
entries.description: Suttida Attana is a corpse in the crypt underneath the Open Hand Temple in Rivington. He is raised as a Greater Zombie, if the party refuses to take the curse from the  Sentient Amulet (Rare).

entries.name: Svend
entries.description: Svend is a human in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Sylbert
entries.description: Healer Sylbert is tending to an old veteran in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Syllabub Fran
entries.description: Syllabub Fran, also known as Shimmer the Siren, is a drunk performer in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Syllving
entries.description: Fist Healer Syllving is a is a dwarven healer and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is on the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Sylvie Summerworth
entries.description: Sylvie Summerworth is a halfling resident of Rivington. She is complaining about the treatment of her letters at the Sword Coast Couriers during Act Three.

entries.name: Syril Valdemar
entries.description: Syril Valdemar is a replacement character as editor-in-chief for  Ettvard Needle in Baldur's Mouth in the Lower City.

entries.name: Syrin
entries.description: Syrin is a human servant of the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Taeglyn
entries.description: Taeglyn, named in-game as Dead Elf, whose corpse is in the Shattered Sanctum of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Tahan
entries.description: Tahan is one of the druids performing the Rite of Thorns during Act One.

entries.name: Taima
entries.description: Pilgrim Taima is a human in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Tairn
entries.description: Tairn is a half-orc guard working for Entharl Danthelon in Danthelon's Dancing Axe in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Tak
entries.description: Tracker Tak is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Tale
entries.description: Tale is a named worg in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Talli
entries.description: Quartermaster Talli is a human Harper quartermaster at the Last Light Inn in Act Two.

entries.name: Talli Armbrust
entries.description: Talli Armbrust is a human in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Taman
entries.description: Taman is a cautious bandit looting the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Tamara
entries.description: Clerk Tamara is a trader of the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, during Act Three. She can be spoken with while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Tambourine
entries.description: Tambourine is a blue-eyed, medium haired white cat in Act Three.

entries.name: Tamia Holzt
entries.description: Tamia Holzt is a Black Gauntlet of Bane on the main floor of the Steel Watch Foundry at X: -292 Y: -147.

entries.name: Tara
entries.description: Tara is a  Tressym, a cat-like Monstrosity. She is  Gale's fluffy companion and assistant.

entries.name: Taraji
entries.description: Fist Taraji is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Tarhun Mnemonis
entries.description: Tarhun Mnemonis is a white dragonborn and butler to  Lady Jannath. He can be found outside the front door of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Taron
entries.description: Taron named in-game as Dead Half-Elf, is a dead adventurer in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Taslim
entries.description: Cashguard Taslim is a member of the Cashguard for the Counting House in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tate
entries.description: Tate is a human child in Lower City in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Tecochi
entries.description: Chef's Assistant Tecochi is an employee at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Tecothy
entries.description: Tecothy is a Petrified drow ranger in the Underdark.

entries.name: Teebs
entries.description: Harper Teebs is a Harper who patrols the southern side of the Last Light Inn docks during Act Two.

entries.name: Teela
entries.description: Teela is  Kagha's death viper snake. She is loyal to Kagha, but may be willing to listen to reason over her owner. She is in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Teghun
entries.description: Teghun is a sleeping bugbear in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Terradissia
entries.description: Harper Terradissia is a Harper guarding the entrance to the Last Light Inn in Act Two. She is positioned atop the guard tower by the entry bridge.

entries.name: Terse Torvalt
entries.description: Terse Torvalt is a halfling member of The Guild.

entries.name: Teth'ka
entries.description: Teth'ka, named in-game as Dead Githyanki Warrior, is a githyanki fighter in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

entries.name: Thadwick
entries.description: Fist Thadwick is a gruff Flaming Fist under the command of  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.

entries.name: Thamberg
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Thamberg is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Thaniel
entries.description: Thaniel is an unaging nature-spirit, appearing as a tiefling child, who embodies the spirit of the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

entries.name: That Which Guards
entries.description: That Which Guards is a death knight guarding the entrance to the Hall of The Murder Tribunal, located in Bhaalist Crypt.

entries.name: That Which Lurks
entries.description: That Which Lurks is a death knight guarding the entrance to the Hall of The Murder Tribunal, located in Bhaalist Crypt.

entries.name: That Which Watches
entries.description: That Which Watches is a death knight guarding the entrance to the Hall of The Murder Tribunal, located in Bhaalist Crypt.

entries.name: Thauniel Rusk
entries.description: Fist Rusk is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: The Dark Urge (Origin)
entries.description: The Dark Urge is a special origin in Baldur's Gate 3. It can be customised to any race, class, and gender, and will not be part of player's party if they use any other origin character.

entries.name: The Emperor
entries.description: The Emperor is a  Mind Flayer (creature) who appears in Baldur's Gate 3. It plays a key role in the main story, but its identity is intentionally obscured until later parts of the game, allowing the player character to ultimately decide for themselves if they want to know more about it, and whether or not it is trustworthy.

entries.name: The Judge
entries.description: The Judge is a named Shadow creature in The Wyrmway in Act Three.

entries.name: The Netherbrain
entries.description: The Netherbrain is an Aberration of massive proportions that serves as the final boss of the game. An Elder Brain enslaved and empowered by the ancient Crown of Karsus, the Netherbrain is the overarching antagonist of the game, with insidious plans supported by it having set in motion the events of the story.

entries.name: The Professor
entries.description: The Professor is an elven member of The Guild.

entries.name: The Warden
entries.description: The Warden is at Moonrise Towers Prison during Act Two, where she presides as warden.

entries.name: Theda Grosz
entries.description: Theda Grosz is watching the Flaming Fist patrols in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Thenar
entries.description: Thenar is an Undead Ghast in Act Three.

entries.name: Theoda
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Theoda is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Theologist Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Theologist Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Therezzyn
entries.description: Kith'rak Therezzyn is the Kith'rak of Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Thindo Vintervur
entries.description: Thindo Vintervur is a lightfoot halfling member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Thisobald Thorm
entries.description: Thisobald Thorm is a unique, intelligent Undead, and the master brewer of The Waning Moon. He is possibly the son of  Ketheric Thorm.

entries.name: Thodric Shedeveer
entries.description: Thodric Shedeveer is a cheery fishmonger in Wyrm's Crossing.

entries.name: Thomas C. Quirkilious
entries.description: Thomas C. Quirkilious is a dragonborn trader and owner of the Chromatic Scale in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Thonos
entries.description: Gavv, disguised as Harper Thonos, is a Doppelganger posing as a gold dwarf member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Thonos was killed and impersonated some time ago.

entries.name: Thorne
entries.description: Waiter Thorne is one of the employees of Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Thrastle Muria
entries.description: Thrastle Muria can be found at the Basilisk Gate Barracks in Act Three.

entries.name: Three
entries.description: Three is a goblin child in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Three-Piece
entries.description: Three-Piece is a member of The Guild.

entries.name: Thrumbo
entries.description: Thrumbo is an undead zombie living in Vonayn's Home in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Thudd
entries.description: Thudd is a Flameshade duergar barbarian who can be found in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Thulla
entries.description: Thulla is an Ironhand gnome in Ebonlake Grotto in Act One.

entries.name: Thunder (Flaming Fist)
entries.description: Gauntlet Thunder is a dwarven cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Thyssa Shineboot
entries.description: Thyssa Shineboot is a lightfoot halfling woh can be encountered outside Elerrathin's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three. She is criticizing  Bastian d'Zinn for overreacting to a child's prank.

entries.name: Tiernan Wont
entries.description: Tiernan Wont is a half-elven customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Tilly
entries.description: Tilly is a civilian. She is behind a locked door in the courtyard of High Hall during the final sequence of Act Three.

entries.name: Tilses
entries.description: Tilses is a tiefling refugee and former Hellrider seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She was  Zevlor's former lieutenant and now acts as his second, helping manage the scouts sent ahead to find a way to Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Timber
entries.description: Timber is a squirrel in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Tina Two-Thumbs
entries.description: Tina Two-Thumbs is a Lightfoot halfling. She is near the broken cart east of the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Tingmiaq
entries.description: Tingmiaq is a blue jay that can be found next to  Apikusis in the Sacred Pool of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Tinsy Ralpp
entries.description: Seawind Tinsy Ralpp is a Savage Seawind of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Tiny (Goblin)
entries.description: Brawler Tiny is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Tizg
entries.description: Tracker Tizg is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Togarr
entries.description: Fist Togarr is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tolna Tome-Monger
entries.description: Tolna Tome-Monger is a merchant and curator of rare books and scrolls at the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City.

entries.name: Tomboldt the Pallid
entries.description: Tomboldt the Pallid is a Lolth-Sworn Drow. He is on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, and can be encountered while following the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Tongs Stoneheart
entries.description: Tongs Stoneheart is a regular patron at a tavern in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tooralooralayo
entries.description: Tooralooralayo is a human civilian who is behind the Elfsong Tavern during Act Three.

entries.name: Topaz (Blue Jay)
entries.description: Topaz is a bird in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Torgga
entries.description: Torgga is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Toron
entries.description: Toron is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He cares and tends to the refugees' oxen.

entries.name: Torrack
entries.description: Tracker Torrack is a goblin tracker in the Underground Passage during Act One. He and his fellow goblins have captured  Findal.

entries.name: Tra'an
entries.description: Youth Tra'an is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Triava
entries.description: Cashguard Artillerist Triava is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Trinigan Gazotts
entries.description: Trinigan Gazotts is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Trinoda
entries.description: Trinoda is a high elf ranger backup leader of the Zhentarim. She may try to take over the Guildhall in Act Three.

entries.name: Trinzas
entries.description: Warrior Trinzas is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Tristan
entries.description: Fist Recruit Tristan is a human ranger and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. He can be found on the Risen Road in Act One.

entries.name: Truffles Smythe
entries.description: Truffles Smythe is a human patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three.

entries.name: Trunk (goblin)
entries.description: Warrior Trunk is a goblin raider who participates in the raid on the Emerald Grove during the quest ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Trynn
entries.description: Trynn is a halfling, formerly dedicated to  Tyr during Act One. She is hunting for  Karlach with her companions along The Risen Road.

entries.name: Tska'an
entries.description: Ch'r'ai Tska'an is a githyanki warlock. She is near the exit of Act Two, the Road to Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Tud
entries.description: Warlock Tud is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Tud Whetstone
entries.description: Tud Whetstone is a dwarf patron of the Blushing Mermaid. He is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tuffet
entries.description: Tuffet is a bear in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Tugelnhorn
entries.description: Tugelnhorn struggles with working conditions but hesitates to join an employee strike in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tuloria
entries.description: Tuloria is a human civilian waiting in a queue with her partner  Sula Ghevora in the Lower City, hoping to enter the Upper City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tumeril
entries.description: Harper Tumeril is a young Harper who guards the entrance to Last Light Inn during Act Two.

entries.name: Turnip Bubbs
entries.description: Turnip Bubbs is a farmer who recently arrived in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tusgront
entries.description: Tusgront is an enforcer for the Guild who can be found in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Tusk
entries.description: Tusk is a boar in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Tut Thistlebog
entries.description: Tut Thistlebog is a guest of The Guild, drinking with  Phostlethwaite in the Guildhall at X: -16 Y: 741.

entries.name: Twitch Broven
entries.description: Twitch Broven is a war veteran in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Two-Toes Rischer
entries.description: Two-Toes Rischer, disguised as a Tipplesome Patron, is a Redcap Mystic Cannoneer in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tylda
entries.description: Tylda is a Sharran Novice within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

entries.name: Tylman Sands
entries.description: Tylman Sands is a human civilian participating in the confrontation with  Bastian d'Zinn, outside Elerrathin's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Tym Armbrust
entries.description: Tym Armbrust is a human who works as a tailor in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

entries.name: Uktar
entries.description: Bursar Uktar, or simply Uktar, serves the Guild as elected bursar. He appears during Act Three and is located before the entrance to the bar in the Guildhall.

entries.name: Ul'mirel
entries.description: Ul'mirel is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y’llek during Act One.

entries.name: Ulder Ravengard
entries.description:
Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is the human Supreme Marshall of the Flaming Fist and the father of  Wyll. His story stretches through all three acts of Baldur's Gate 3, and he can become a Camp Follower late in the game. 
Ulder Ravengard is a recurring character in the Forgotten Realms setting of Dungeons and Dragons, appearing in the 5e adventures:  Murder in Baldur's Gate,  The Rise of Tiamat, and  Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus.

entries.name: Ulkov Sully
entries.description: Ulkov Sully is a coffin maker in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Ulma
entries.description: Ulma is the human leader of the Gur. She is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Ulnar
entries.description: Ulnar is an undead ghast in Act Three.

entries.name: Ulova
entries.description: Black Gauntlet Ulova is a cultist of Bane in Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

entries.name: Ulthred
entries.description: Fist Ulthred is a human Flaming Fist at the Last Light Inn. He can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Ulumpha
entries.description: Ulumpha is a member of the Dead Eyes, a bandit group in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Umbrenne
entries.description: Umbrenne is an elven prophet of  Talona, preaching to two civilians in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Umi
entries.description: Umi is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Umr'a'ac
entries.description: Gish Umr'a'ac is a gish in Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Un'n
entries.description: Raider Un'n is a githyanki raider in Crèche Y’llek in Act One.

entries.name: Unclean Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Unclean Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Unilda Tiro
entries.description: Guard Unilda Tiro is a human guard in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Ur'uth
entries.description: Ur'uth is a wolf in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Ursa
entries.description: Ursa is a bear summoned via a Beast Master's  Bear Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Ursa "upgrades" to  Ursa Major once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Ursa Ingens once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Ursa Ingens
entries.description: Ursa Ingens is a bear summoned via a Beast Master's  Bear Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Ursa Ingens is the fully upgraded form of  Ursa and  Ursa Major once the Beast Master has reached level 11.

entries.name: Ursa Major
entries.description: Ursa Major is a bear summoned via a Beast Master's  Bear Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Ursa Major is upgraded from  Ursa once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Ursa Ingens once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Us
entries.description: Us is an Intellect Devourer and possible Attached Follower which is in the Prologue of Baldur's Gate 3 aboard the Nautiloid, trapped inside the head of an Elf named  Myrnath.

entries.name: Uttermask
entries.description: Uttermask is a Sharran Fidelian within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace located at X: -391 Y: -1663.

entries.name: Uva
entries.description: Uva is a Black Gauntlet of Bane.

entries.name: Vagga
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Vagga is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the High Security Vaults in the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Valeria
entries.description: Investigator Valeria is a Hollyphant in the Open Hand Temple.

entries.name: Valmorba
entries.description: Valmorba is a high half-elven gravekeeper in the Mortuary within the Graveyard in Baldur's Gate 3. She is a devotee of Kelemvor and manages the graveyard.

entries.name: Vance (Dead Toll Collector)
entries.description: Vance, named in-game as Dead Toll Collector, is a dead human whose corpse is in Act One.

entries.name: Vanessa
entries.description: Sister Vanessa is an undead nurse in the House of Healing, situated in the town of Reithwin, during Act Two.

entries.name: Vanja
entries.description: Vanja is an Undead Vampire Spawn imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon. He is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by  Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn.

entries.name: Vanra Bergauz
entries.description: Vanra, or Vanra Bergauz, is the subject of the quest ⁠Save Vanra. Vanra is  Lora's daughter.

entries.name: Varanna Sunblossom
entries.description: Varanna Sunblossom is a Wood Half-Elf Fighter specialized in the defence fighting style. As a hireling, she can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Varderola
entries.description: Varderola is a human servant of the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Varneela
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Varneela is a member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Varone
entries.description: Fist Varone is a human wizard and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Varrl
entries.description: Youth Varrl is a student in the Classroom of Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Vatas
entries.description: Vatas is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Velki
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Velki is a human Reaper of Bhaal.

entries.name: Velson Oakes
entries.description: Velson Oakes is a trader in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.

entries.name: Ver'yll Wenkiir
entries.description: Ver'yll Wenkiir is a Seldarine Drow Ranger, specialising in mage breaking and beast taming. As a hireling, he can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Verik
entries.description: Zephyr Gish'ra Verik is a githyanki character encountered in the Astral Plane at the end of Act Two. She is part of  Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him.

entries.name: Vermit
entries.description: Vermit, named in-game as Goblin, is a dead goblin.

entries.name: Verres
entries.description: Verres is a boar summoned via a Beast Master's  Boar Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Verres "upgrades" to  Verres Major once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Verres Calamitosus once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Verres Calamitosus
entries.description: Verres Calamitosus is a boar summoned via a Beast Master's  Boar Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Verres Calamitosus is the fully upgraded form of  Verres and  Verres Major once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Verres Major
entries.description: Verres Major is a boar summoned via a Beast Master's  Boar Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Verres Major is upgraded from  Verres once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Verres Calamitosus once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

entries.name: Vez
entries.description: Brawler Vez is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two. She stands next to  Kansif and  Warrior Gronag, if they are led there by  Sharp-Eye Lora.

entries.name: Vharranne
entries.description: Bully Gal Vharranne is a Human in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She is near the Grey Harbour Docks, as part of  Churg Elvek's mob, ready to bring  Volo to "justice".

entries.name: Vhynce
entries.description: Tailor Vhynce appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Viconia DeVir
entries.description: Viconia DeVir is a drow cleric of Shar. She is the Mother Superior of the  Shar enclave in Baldur's Gate. She is a returning character from Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn, where she was a companion.
