entries.name: Victoria
entries.description: Victoria Onufrio is a deceased human child in the guest room of Szarr Palace during Act Three. She has the rather unusual condition  Sapping Curse.

entries.name: Vidor
entries.description: Manip Vidor is a senior Manip of the Flaming Fist. Appearing alongside  Counsellor Florrick in Last Light Inn, he is her second-in-command during their attempted rescue of  Duke Ravengard.

entries.name: Vikki
entries.description: Cashguard Basher Vikki, is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House, in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Vilhelm
entries.description: Vilhelm is a human servant of the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Vilmina
entries.description: Dark Breaker Vilmina is a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, in Act Three.

entries.name: Vin Dorgo
entries.description: Vin Dorgo is a drunk patron of the Blushing Mermaid in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Vinegaroon
entries.description: Vinegaroon is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.

entries.name: Viola Silvertongue
entries.description: Viola Silvertongue is a human Bard performing at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three.

entries.name: Violet
entries.description: Violet is a vampire spawn bound to  Cazador Szarr, and one of  Astarion's siblings. She may appear at camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Vis'kiir
entries.description: Youth Vis'kiir is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Visage of Cowardice
entries.description: Visage of Cowardice is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visage of Greed
entries.description: Visage of Greed is a Grim Visage in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visage of Guilt
entries.description: Visage of Guilt is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visage of Heartlessness
entries.description: Visage of Heartlessness is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visage of Obedience
entries.description: Visage of Obedience is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visage of Regret
entries.description: Visage of Regret is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.

entries.name: Visionary Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Visionary Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Viss
entries.description: Viss is clearing deep gnome corpses in Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Vix
entries.description: Roustabout Vix is a High Half-Elf found in the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington. He is sleeping in the off-limits dressing room area, unless combat starts – after which he will wander around.

entries.name: Vlaakith
entries.description: Vlaakith CLVII is the current and undying ruler of the Githyanki. She oversees their operations in all the planes, and at the time of the events of Baldur's Gate 3, is actively seeking the Mysterious Artefact that was stolen from her. She can also be chosen as a patron deity by githyanki clerics.

entries.name: Vol
entries.description: Vol is a human in the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Volgu Drak
entries.description: Fist of Bane Volgu Drak is human follower of  Bane, He is next to a ledge on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Volo
entries.description: Volothamp Geddarm, or Volo, for short, is a Camp Follower in Baldur's Gate 3. He is first located at the Sacred Pool during Act One, interviewing a bear. Volo is a recurring character in  Forgotten Realms media and a returning character from Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal.

entries.name: Voss
entries.description: Kith'rak Voss is a determined Githyanki knight in the service of his queen,  Vlaakith. He rides a red dragon named  Qudenos.

entries.name: Voss' Raider
entries.description: Voss' Raider is a githyanki NPC encountered in Act One. They cannot be spoken to and are functionally identical to a generic githyanki raider, other than wielding a different weapon.

entries.name: Voyeur Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Voyeur Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Vraalsith
entries.description: Ardent Vraalsith is a member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue in Act One.

entries.name: Vrak
entries.description: Butcher Vrak is a goblin stationed at the Worg Pens in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Vrindula Mardassus
entries.description: Vrindula Mardassus is a civilian in front of the Counting House, in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Vu'un
entries.description: Warrior Vu’un is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: W'wargaz
entries.description: Ch'r'ai W'wargaz is the inquisitor leading  Vlaakith's search for the Mysterious Artefact during Act One.

entries.name: Waldemar Prinski
entries.description: Waldemar Prinski is a human cultist of Bane.

entries.name: Waltzing Eternal Debtor
entries.description: Waltzing Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.

entries.name: Wanda Tullermoor
entries.description: Wanda Tullermoor is a human wizard and ally of  Counsellor Florrick. She is part of the retinue which confronts the party after  Wyll breaks his pact with  Mizora.

entries.name: Warryn
entries.description: Warryn guards the Chapel Entrance of the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

entries.name: Wasp
entries.description: Devout Wasp is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Watcher Guardian
entries.description: Watcher Guardians are summonable allies during Confront the Elder Brain, using their great weapon mastery to protect the city against the Absolutist forces' incursion.

entries.name: Wayne
entries.description: Fist Wayne is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Welso
entries.description: Welso is an Ironhand gnome digging through rubble in the Grymforge during Act One.

entries.name: Weneg
entries.description: Brawler Weneg is a goblin brawler in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Wensleydale
entries.description: Wensleydale is an undead Vampire Spawn imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon.

entries.name: Werewolf (creature)
entries.description: Werewolf is a creature that can be summoned with  Retinue of the Vampire Lord during the endgame in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Wexford
entries.description: Flaming Fist Wexford is a Flaming Fist who is killed by a githyanki patrol along the Risen Road at X: -145 Y: 570.

entries.name: Whitemist
entries.description: Whitemist is a Dire Wolf in the ballroom of Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate 3.

entries.name: Wicky
entries.description: Wicky is a member of the Clan Ironhand gnomes trapped with  Nere in Act One.

entries.name: Wilbur
entries.description: Griefguard Wilbur is a Sharran Novice in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Willinx Jindlebee
entries.description: Willinx Jindlebee is a necromancer of the Cult of Myrkul found in Act Two. She appears in the Moonrise Towers Prison after the party launch ⁠the assault on the cult.

entries.name: Willow
entries.description: Willow is a human child who can be encountered inside the Felogyr's Fireworks in Lower City of the Baldur's Gate, in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠Investigate the Suspicious Toys.

entries.name: Wilting Alex
entries.description: Wilting Alex is a dead Human whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Wim
entries.description: Brawler Wim is a goblin brawler in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.

entries.name: Winslow Reginol
entries.description: Winslow Reginol is a dead blue dragonborn whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three.

entries.name: Winstra Hullhollyn
entries.description: Lady Winstra Hullhollyn is a patriar of Baldur's Gate who is present at  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.

entries.name: Wise Sentinel
entries.description: The Wise Sentinel is a unique type of Undead guarding the secret shrine to Shar underneath the statue of Ketheric Thorm in Reithwin Town's square. Its abilities mirror that of a Cleric, and fitting of its role it has very high Wisdom.

entries.name: Withers
entries.description: Withers is a mysterious Undead entity who joins the party on their adventures as a Camp Follower. He calls himself "a scribe, a seneschal - a keeper of records". He offers resurrection and Hireling services to the party, and also allows respeccing of characters.

entries.name: Worm
entries.description: Tracker Worm is a goblin tracker in the Underground Passage in Act One. She and her fellow goblins have captured  Findal.

entries.name: Wren
entries.description: Wren is a lightfoot halfling druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One.

entries.name: Wrenfrew the Barker
entries.description: Wrenfrew the Barker is a human noble. He flees the High Hall upon entering.

entries.name: Wrint Sprigley
entries.description: Wrint Sprigley works for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Wulbren Bongle
entries.description: Wulbren Bongle is a deep gnome who leads the Ironhand Gnomes. Wulbren despises the Gondians and the Steel Watch, and works to destroy the Steel Watch Foundry in Baldur's Gate and rid the city of Gondians.

entries.name: Wulbren Bongle/Zombie
entries.description: Zombie Wulbren is a Zombie encountered in Act Two.

entries.name: Wuloona Dor
entries.description: Wuloona Dor is a dwarven civilian upset at the propaganda being pushed by the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Wyll
entries.description:
Wyll Ravengard is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a Human and a Fiend Warlock with the Folk Hero background. Wyll is first encountered just outside the Emerald Grove in Act One.
Known as the "Blade of Frontiers" across the marches of Baldur's Gate, Wyll is a valiant hero who fights injustice and hunts monsters wherever they may hide. Though forever bound to his infernal patron  Mizora, he has dedicated his whole life to protecting the city he loves.
In multiplayer sessions, if Wyll is chosen as an origin by a player, Karlach is locked out as an option to other players.

entries.name: Wynn Freshwater
entries.description: Wynn Freshwater is an elven civilian walking around the Upper City Gate Checkpoint in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Xargrim
entries.description: Xargrim, named in-game as Pale Corpse, was one of the three drow explorers in the Underdark searching for the Adamantine Forge in Act One.

entries.name: Xeph
entries.description: Xeph is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Xon'ar'as
entries.description: Warrior Xon'ar'as is a githyanki warrior found in Act One.

entries.name: Yafeu
entries.description: Yafeu is a djinni in Baldur's Gate 3, found trapped within a Djinni Lamp in the Sorcerous Vault.

entries.name: Yannis
entries.description: Sister Yannis, also known as Rector Yannis, is a halfling follower of Ilmater and the woman in charge of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Yenna
entries.description: Yenna is a Human and potential Camp Follower living in Rivington with her mother and her cat,  Grub.

entries.name: Yerle
entries.description: Yerle is a member of the Zhentarim who guards  Roah Moonglow alongside  Erna in the Shattered Sanctum and Moonrise Towers.

entries.name: Yeva
entries.description: Yeva is a human fighter and a Gauntlet of the Flaming Fist. She can be encountered in Act One and Act Two of the game.

entries.name: Yimuir
entries.description: Yimuir, or Waiter Yimuir, is a waiter in the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Yonas
entries.description: Harper Yonas is a Harper ranger in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

entries.name: Yonks
entries.description: Yonks is a gnome adventurer. He is meeting up with his group in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Yonni
entries.description: Cashguard Yonni is a human member of the Cashguard of the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Yoonce
entries.description: Iron Consul Underbite Yoonce is a cultist of Bane.

entries.name: Yousen
entries.description: Yousen is a vampire spawn enslaved to Cazador, and one of  Astarion's siblings. He may appear at camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

entries.name: Yr'rk
entries.description: Warrior Yr’rk is a githyanki in Crèche Y’llek in Act One.

entries.name: Yul
entries.description: Yul can be found dead along the Mountain Pass in Act One.

entries.name: Yurgir
entries.description: Yurgir is an Orthon, a powerful type of Fiend from the Nine Hells. He and his band of Merregon Legionnaires are in the Gauntlet of Shar, where they have been trapped by a consequence of design from a contract with  Raphael.

entries.name: Yy'rul
entries.description: Gish Yy'rul is a githyanki gish in Act One. She is a member of githyanki commune residing in Crèche Y’llek before arrival of Inquisitor W’wargaz’s.

entries.name: Z'rell
entries.description: Disciple Z'rell is a high-ranking Absolutist and trusted advisor to  Ketheric Thorm in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.

entries.name: Za'krug
entries.description: Za'krug is the goblin boss leading an attack on the Emerald Grove at the start of Act One.

entries.name: Zae
entries.description: Zae is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Zaki
entries.description: Zaki is a tiefling refugee seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One.

entries.name: Zakk
entries.description: Ploughman Zakk is a farmer who recently arrived in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Zambomba
entries.description: Zambomba is a medium haired grey cat with yellow eyes in the Elfsong Tavern of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Zami
entries.description: Sharp-Eye Zami is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One.

entries.name: Zanner Toobin
entries.description: Zanner Toobin is a Rock Gnome, first found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Act Three. If the party helps to save the kidnapped Gondians in the Iron Throne, he becomes an Attached Follower while progressing through the Foundry.

entries.name: Zar'a'ath
entries.description: Youth Zar'a'ath  is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Zar'an
entries.description: Raider Zar'an is a githyanki in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.

entries.name: Zara
entries.description: Zara the Mummy is a Mummy trader at the Circus of the Last Days. She sells dyes and disguise kits, though her intentions as a trader are hidden behind muffled grunts.

entries.name: Zarys
entries.description: Zarys leads the group of Zhentarim occupying the Zhentarim Basement in Act One.

entries.name: Zastreya
entries.description: Zastreya is an Untaken of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

entries.name: Zastri
entries.description: Raider Zastri is a githyanki raider on the Mountain Pass during Act One.

entries.name: Zeffy Softbluff
entries.description: Zeffy Softbluff is a Lightfoot halfling. He is near the broken cart east of the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Zeironymous
entries.description: Night Blade Zeironymous is a human Night Blade in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Zel'i
entries.description: Zel'i is a a member of the a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y'llek during Act One.

entries.name: Zelrin
entries.description: High Gish'ra Zelrin is a githyanki character encountered at the Wyrm's Crossing campsite at the end of Act Two.

entries.name: Zena
entries.description: Zena can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

entries.name: Zenith Feur'sel
entries.description: Zenith Feur'sel is a High Elf Cleric of the Light Domain who worships Selûne. As a hireling, he can be recruited at camp and respecced at any time.

entries.name: Zenovia Dawg
entries.description: Zenovia Dawg is a leader of the Rivington Rats, a criminal gang affiliated to The Guild. She is in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Zerentha
entries.description: Raider Zerentha is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Zerillis
entries.description: Reaper of Bhaal Zerillis is a human member of the Cult of Bhaal, in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: Zerillo
entries.description: Zerillo is one of the children at the square in front of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three.

entries.name: Zethino
entries.description: Zethino is a dryad who works at the Circus of the Last Days.

entries.name: Zevlor
entries.description: Zevlor is the leader of a group of Tiefling refugees who are traveling to Baldur's Gate after being exiled from their home. He and his fellow tieflings are found hiding within the Emerald Grove.

entries.name: Zgorrellik
entries.description: Zgorrellik appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

entries.name: Zhalk
entries.description: Commander Zhalk is a cambion in the service of Zariel. He is an optional boss during the Prologue.

entries.name: Zhendila
entries.description: Veteran Gish Zhendila is a githyanki soldier.

entries.name: Zhent Elf
entries.description: Zhent Elf is a Zhentarim mercenary who can be summoned during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain in Act Three.

entries.name: Zhent Half-Elven
entries.description: Zhent Half-Elven is a Zhentarim mercenary who can be summoned during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain in Act Three.

entries.name: Zhentmodeus
entries.description: Zhentmodeus is a Zhentarim mercenary who was likely intended be summoned during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain in Act Three.

entries.name: Zina
entries.description: Zina is an undead ghost dog in the Durinbold Mausoleum in Baldur's Gate's Lower City.

entries.name: Zira
entries.description: Zealot Zira is stationed in the Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two.

entries.name: Zog
entries.description: Zog is a half-orc adventurer. He is is meeting up with his group in Rivington in Act Three.

entries.name: Zola
entries.description: Zola is a courier dog employed by  Angry Mar'hyah at the Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington during Act Three.

entries.name: Zollerix
entries.description: Clerk Zollerix is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City.

entries.name: Zomm
entries.description: Zomm is a Doppelganger in the Under Temple Cave Area under the Open Hand Temple in Act Three.

entries.name: Zorru
entries.description: Zorru is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. Originally out on a scouting mission with  Yul, he encountered a githyanki patrol on the Risen Road before fleeing back to the grove.

entries.name: Zoryxx
entries.description: Prayerboy Zoryxx is a Dragonborn who is a part of  Aradin's mercenary crew if he confronts the player's party at camp during Act Three.

entries.name: Zumbo Pumbo
entries.description: Zumbo Pumbo is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

entries.name: Zunii
entries.description: Veteran Raider Zunii is a githyanki Veteran Raider who lies in wait to ambush the party near the Road to Baldur's Gate in Reithwin Town within the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

entries.name: Zurga
entries.description: Zurga is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp during Act One.

entries.name: Zurk
entries.description: Beastmaster Zurk is a goblin stationed at the Worg Pens in the Goblin Camp during Act One. He is responsible for care of the  Worgs.

entries.name: Zyrlak
entries.description: Gate Master Zyrlak is a githyanki in the Knights of the Shield Hideout in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
